title: Measles transmission-related epidemiological parameter estimates: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
abstract: Abstract With the recent resurgence of global measles outbreaks, it is crucial to understand measles transmission dynamics to guide timely and effective public health responses and parameterize infectious disease models for accurate outbreak projections. This systematic review aims to provide a comprehensive resource of measles transmission-related epidemiological parameters. A search was conducted from inception to 14 May 2024. English and French primary studies of transmission-related epidemiological parameters were included, and standard systematic review methodology was followed. Evidence was synthesized using random-effects meta-analyses and descriptive plots. Subgroup analyses by World Health Organization (WHO) region, population, decade, and quality of reporting were conducted to explore heterogeneity. Between 1910 and 2024, 1 209 estimates across 32 transmission-related epidemiological parameters from 612 studies were reported. Measles was characterized by a pooled incubation period (13.5 days, 95%CI 12.6–14.4; I2 = 95.9%), serial interval (12.4 days, 95%CI 11.5–13.4; I2 = 97.6%), symptom onset to hospitalization (4.8 days, 95%CI 3.7–5.8, I2 = 99.7%), and basic reproduction number median 11.5 (range of 0–57). This work is part of a global epidemic preparedness and response project to establish an accessible living Global Repository of Epidemiological Parameters aimed at reducing duplicative efforts in identifying and summarizing epidemiological parameters.

abstract_zh: 摘要:随着最近全球 麻疹 暴发 的复苏,了解 麻疹 传播 动态对于指导及时有效的公共卫生应对措施和参数化传染病模型以进行准确的 麻疹 预测至关重要。本系统综述旨在提供 麻疹 传播 相关流行病学参数的综合资源。检索从开始到2024年5月14日进行。纳入了传播相关流行病学参数的英语和法语初步研究,并遵循标准系统评价方法。使用随机效应荟萃分析和描述性图合成证据。按世界卫生组织 (WHO) 地区、人口、十年和报告质量进行亚组分析,以探讨异质性。1910 年至 2024 年间,报告了 612 项研究中 32 个 传播 相关流行病学参数的 1 209 项估计值。麻疹 的特点是合并潜伏期(13.5 天,95% CI 12.6–14.4;I2 = 95.9%)、连续间隔(12.4 天,95% CI 11.5–13.4;I2 = 97.6%)、症状出现到住院(4.8 天,95% CI 3.7–5.8,I2 = 99.7%),基本再生数中位数为 11.5(范围为 0-57)。这项工作是全球流行病防范和应对项目的一部分,该项目旨在建立一个可访问的全球流行病学参数存储库,旨在减少识别和总结流行病学参数的重复工作。

title: Impact of a large measles outbreak associated with transmission in the Americas and Canada's loss of measles elimination status: descriptive cohort study.
abstract: Abstract Objective To describe the epidemiological characteristics, public health response, and evidence of international spread of a large measles outbreak that contributed to the loss of Canada’s measles elimination status. Design Descriptive analysis of the cohort of measles outbreak cases reported to Ontario’s public health surveillance system during the outbreak period: epidemiological week of 28 October 2024 to 6 October 2025. Setting Ontario, Canada. Participants Individuals meeting the outbreak case definition for confirmed or probable measles infection during the outbreak period. Exposure Exposure to measles virus associated with the Ontario outbreak and related transmission chains. Main outcome measures Demographic characteristics, vaccination status, admission to hospital, complications, pregnancy associated outcomes, mortality, and evidence of international spread based on measles virus genotyping and sequencing. Cases were identified using an outbreak-specific case definition incorporating epidemiological, clinical, laboratory, and viral sequencing criteria. Phylogenetic analysis of measles virus sequences was used to assess evidence of onwards spread to other countries. Results The outbreak consisted of 2377 cases (2064 confirmed and 313 probable) over 49 weeks and contributed to the loss of Canada’s measles elimination status. Most cases (2146/2377, 90.3%) occurred among members of historically under-vaccinated communities, with limited spillover into the broader population. Among the 2377 cases, approximately three quarters of cases (n=1736, 73.0%) occurred in individuals aged 19 years or younger, 2121 (89.2%) were unvaccinated, and 97 (4.1%) had unknown vaccination status. The outbreak was associated with 166 (7%) admissions to hospital, 13 (<1%) admissions to intensive care unit, 51 (2.1%) infections during pregnancy, 10 (<1%) congenital measles infections, one (<1%) case of encephalitis, and one (<1%) infant death. Sequencing identified a novel N450 distinct sequence identifier that was subsequently detected in countries including the United States of America, Mexico, and the Netherlands. The outbreak strain was designated a World Health Organization named strain (MVs/Ontario.CAN/47.24). Conclusions These findings highlight the risk of measles re-establishment in countries that have attained elimination and underscore the importance of culturally appropriate community engagement to build trust in immunisation and prevent future outbreaks. This outbreak shows the fragility of measles elimination in the presence of long standing immunity gaps within interconnected communities across the Americas and the population-level protection that limited broader community transmission.

The outbreak strain was identified as a novel N450 sequence and later detected in other countries, including the United States, Mexico, and the Netherlands. title_zh: 与美洲和加拿大 麻疹 消除状态丧失相关的 麻疹 相关的大型 麻疹 暴发 的影响:描述性 队列研究 研究。
source_body_en: Abstract Objective To describe the epidemiological characteristics, public health response, and evidence of international spread of a large measles outbreak that contributed to the loss of Canada’s measles elimination status. Design Descriptive analysis of the cohort of measles outbreak cases reported to Ontario’s public health surveillance system during the outbreak period: epidemiological week of 28 October 2024 to 6 October 2025. Setting Ontario, Canada. Participants Individuals meeting the outbreak case definition for confirmed or probable measles infection during the outbreak period. Exposure Exposure to measles virus associated with the Ontario outbreak and related transmission chains. Main outcome measures Demographic characteristics, vaccination status, admission to hospital, complications, pregnancy associated outcomes, mortality, and evidence of international spread based on measles virus genotyping and sequencing. Cases were identified using an outbreak-specific case definition incorporating epidemiological, clinical, laboratory, and viral sequencing criteria. Phylogenetic analysis of measles virus sequences was used to assess evidence of onwards spread to other countries. Results The outbreak consisted of 2377 cases (2064 confirmed and 313 probable) over 49 weeks and contributed to the loss of Canada’s measles elimination status. Most cases (2146/2377, 90.3%) occurred among members of historically under-vaccinated communities, with limited spillover into the broader population. Among the 2377 cases, approximately three quarters of cases (n=1736, 73.0%) occurred in individuals aged 19 years or younger, 2121 (89.2%) were unvaccinated, and 97 (4.1%) had unknown vaccination status. The outbreak was associated with 166 (7%) admissions to hospital, 13 (<1%) admissions to intensive care unit, 51 (2.1%) infections during pregnancy, 10 (<1%) congenital measles infections, one (<1%) case of encephalitis, and one (<1%) infant death. Sequencing identified a novel N450 distinct sequence identifier that was subsequently detected in countries including the United States of America, Mexico, and the Netherlands. The outbreak strain was designated a World Health Organization named strain (MVs/Ontario.CAN/47.24). Conclusions These findings highlight the risk of measles re-establishment in countries that have attained elimination and underscore the importance of culturally appropriate community engagement to build trust in immunisation and prevent future outbreaks. This outbreak shows the fragility of measles elimination in the presence of long standing immunity gaps within interconnected communities across the Americas and the population-level protection that limited broader community transmission.

title: Childhood vaccination timeliness, under-immunization-for-age and measles effective immunity in Peru: a province and birth-cohort analysis of national survey data, 2004-2025.
abstract: BACKGROUND: Using the survey rounds 2004-2025 of Peru's Demographic and Family Health Survey (ENDES) for children aged 12-35 months, we estimated the timeliness of sentinel vaccine doses; under-immunization-for-age and late receipt by province and birth cohort; and the gap between the proportion of children effectively immune to measles and the herd-immunity threshold. METHODS: Pooled cross-sections were analysed. Timeliness was measured in days, within World Health Organization age bands, among children whose vaccination card was seen; weighting and bounds addressed selection. We estimated the share of the maternal-education gap in timeliness running through antenatal and delivery care and fitted Bayesian small-area models for 196 provinces. RESULTS: Among card-seen children, on-time receipt was 86.8% for bacille Calmette-Guérin (BCG), 65.3% for the third dose of diphtheria-tetanus-pertussis (DTP)-containing vaccine (DTP3), 61.1% for the first measles-containing dose and, in survey rounds 2015-2025, 39.2% for the second. For all children in the age band, recall-based bounds put DTP3 timeliness at 54.5%-63.5%, below the card-seen estimate. Children of more educated mothers had a 6.7-point lower risk of DTP3 not on time; under stated assumptions, antenatal care and institutional delivery explained 0.85 points (13%) of this gap. In the 2020-2025 birth cohort, 28 provinces were classed worse than the national level for DTP3 not on time. In the 2020-2024 birth cohort, the province-average proportion of children effectively immune to measles was 89.8%, below the herd-immunity thresholds for a basic reproduction number (R0) of 15-18; for R0 = 12, the average probability that a province fell below the threshold was 59.9%. CONCLUSIONS: Many card-seen children were vaccinated late, and card-based estimates probably overstate DTP3 timeliness. Under the assumed vaccine effectiveness and R0 of 15-18, measles immunity stayed below herd-immunity thresholds.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to estimate the timeliness of measles-containing vaccine doses and assess under-immunization-for-age and the gap between effective measles immunity and herd-immunity thresholds in Peru.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The analysis used pooled cross-sections from the 2004-2025 Demographic and Family Health Survey (ENDES) in Peru, focusing on children aged 12-35 months and the 2020-2025 birth cohort across 196 provinces.
analysis.methods: Timeliness was measured in days within WHO age bands for children with visible vaccination cards, and Bayesian small-area models were fitted to estimate the maternal-education gap in DTP3 timeliness.
analysis.main_results: Among children with seen vaccination cards, on-time receipt of DTP3 was 65.3%, while recall-based bounds suggested a range of 54.5%-63.5%. The measles effective immunity proportion was 89.8% in the 2020-2024 birth cohort, below the herd-immunity thresholds for R0 = 15-18.

analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The results highlight the need for improved vaccination timeliness and surveillance to ensure measles immunity reaches herd-immunity thresholds, particularly in provinces with lower immunization rates.

analysis.summary_en: This study analyzed national survey data from Peru (2004-2025) to assess measles vaccination timeliness, under-immunization-for-age, and effective immunity levels. It found that on-time receipt of DTP3 was 65.3% among children with seen vaccination cards, while recall-based bounds suggested a lower range of 54.5%-63.5%. The measles effective immunity proportion was 89.8% in the 2020-2024 birth cohort, below herd-immunity thresholds for R0 = 15-18. The authors concluded that card-based estimates likely overstate timeliness and that measles immunity remains insufficient in many provinces. The study used Bayesian small-area models to estimate the maternal-education gap in DTP3 timeliness, but recall-based bounds and reliance on survey data introduce uncertainty, limiting the confidence in findings.

abstract_zh: 背景:利用 2004-2025 年秘鲁 12-35 个月儿童人口和家庭健康调查 (ENDES) 的调查,我们估计了哨点 疫苗 剂量的及时性;按年龄划分的免疫接种不足以及按省份和出生日期延迟接收 队列研究;对麻疹有效免疫的儿童比例与群体免疫阈值之间的差距。方法:分析合并的横截面。在世界卫生组织年龄范围内,在看到 疫苗接种 卡的儿童中,及时性以天为单位进行衡量;权重和界限解决了选择问题。我们估算了产前和分娩护理中孕产妇教育及时性差距的比例,并为 196 个省份拟合了贝叶斯小区域模型。结果:在看卡儿童中,卡介苗 (BCG) 按时领取率为 86.8%,含白喉破伤风百日咳 (DTP) 的第三剂 疫苗 (DTP3) 按时领取率为 65.3%,含 麻疹 的第一剂按时领取率为 61.1%,在调查轮次中2015-2025年,39.2%为第二。对于该年龄段的所有儿童,基于回忆的界限使 DTP3 及时性为 54.5%-63.5%,低于卡片可见的估计值。受教育程度较高的母亲的孩子不按时感染 DTP3 的风险要低 6.7 个百分点;根据既定假设,产前护理和机构分娩解释了这一差距的 0.85 个百分点 (13%)。2020-2025年出生队列研究中,有28个省份因DTP3未按时排名低于全国水平。2020-2024年出生的队列研究,全省平均对麻疹有效免疫的儿童比例为89.8%,低于基本繁殖数(R0)15-18的群体免疫阈值;当 R0 = 12 时,一个省份低于阈值的平均概率为 59.9%。结论:许多卡片上看到的儿童接种疫苗较晚,基于卡片的估计可能夸大了 DTP3 的及时性。在假设的 疫苗 有效性和 R0 为 15-18 的情况下,麻疹 免疫力保持在群体免疫阈值以下。

title: Determinants of Measles Vaccine Failure and Breakthrough Infections: A Systematic Review of IgG Avidity Based Immunological Markers and Host Genetic Polymorphisms.
abstract: ABSTRACT Background Measles remains a leading cause of vaccine‐preventable mortality, despite high reported coverage. Determinants of measles vaccine failure remain incompletely characterized. Methods Five databases (PubMed/MEDLINE, Embase, Web of Science, Scopus, Cochrane Library) were searched from inception. Studies in vaccinated individuals evaluating IgG avidity markers or host genetic polymorphisms were included. Risk of bias was assessed using the Newcastle–Ottawa Scale, JBI checklist and modified HuGENet framework. Findings were synthesized narratively (PROSPERO: CRD420261415732). Results Sixteen studies (8169 participants; 1998–2025) met inclusion criteria. Across seven studies with event‐level data, primary vaccine failure ranged from 24.2% to 90.8%. Reproducible host genetic associations were observed for HLA Class I/II alleles, measles receptor genes (SLAM/CD150, CD46, CD209), TLR pathway genes, antiviral effector genes and cytokine/cytokine receptor genes. No study reported extractable breakthrough infection or dichotomous IgG avidity data. Conclusion Reproducible host genetic determinants of measles antibody response cluster at HLA loci, the measles receptor axis and the TLR pathway. Inconsistent definitions and absent standardized reporting preclude firm conclusions. Prospective harmonized studies are required.

analysis_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 十六项研究(8169 名受试者;1998-2025 年)符合纳入标准。在使用事件级数据的七项研究中,主要 疫苗 失败率范围为 24.2% 至 90.8%。在 HLA I/II 类等位基因、麻疹 受体基因(SLAM/CD150、CD46、CD209)、TLR 通路基因、抗病毒药物 效应基因和细胞因子/细胞因子受体基因中观察到可重复的 宿主 遗传关联。没有研究报告可提取的突破性感染或二分 IgG 亲合力数据。HLA 位点、麻疹 受体轴和 TLR 通路上 麻疹 抗体反应簇的可重复 宿主 遗传决定因素。
analysis_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 不一致的定义和缺乏标准化报告无法得出明确的结论。需要进行前瞻性协调研究。
analysis_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 需要在更大、更多样化的人群中复制研究结果。标准化报告和定义对于未来的研究至关重要。需要统一的前瞻性研究来更好地了解 麻疹 疫苗 失败和突破性感染的决定因素。

title: Domestic Measles Importations in Washington State, January 2026.
abstract: AbstractMeasles outbreaks are increasing in frequency and size in the United States. Within 2 weeks, there were five distinct out-of-state measles importations into Washington State epidemiologically connected to an outbreak in South Carolina, resulting in a total of 26 measles cases during January-February 2026. Genomic analyses supported epidemiologic conclusions regarding exposure sources of imported cases and independence among importations. Adherence to isolation and quarantine likely limited onward transmission in undervaccinated communities. Combining timely genomic data analysis with epidemiologic information can strengthen understanding of measles outbreaks as public health jurisdictions prepare to respond to increases in imported measles cases.

title: Spatio-temporal dynamics, transmission hotspots, and vaccination gaps driving measles persistence in Nigeria, 2006-2025.
abstract: BACKGROUND: Measles remains a major public health concern in Nigeria, contributing disproportionately to the global burden. Persistence of the disease is driven by sub-optimal vaccination coverage and heterogeneous transmission patterns, but the specific spatio-temporal dynamics and the quantitative impact of vaccination gaps at the sub-national level are not fully characterized. OBJECTIVE: This study aimed to provide a comprehensive analysis of measles transmission in Nigeria from 2006 to 2025, with the specific objectives to identify spatial hotspots, quantify their temporal persistence, and evaluate the association between MCV1/MCV2 coverage and measles case ratio. METHODS: We conducted a national retrospective ecological study, integrating 19 years of surveillance data (2006-2025) and geospatial information, with a focused 4-year analysis of vaccination records (2021-2024). Analytical methods included time-series decomposition, spatial autocorrelation (Local Moran's I and Getis-Ord Gi*), and linear mixed-effects modeling to quantify vaccination effects while accounting for state-level heterogeneity. RESULTS: Analysis of 253,595 measles cases revealed a highly clustered geographic distribution, with 86.4% of the national burden concentrated in northern Nigeria. We identified 38 persistent hotspot Local Government Areas that accounted for 23.2% of all cases. Vaccination coverage was low and disparate, with national averages of 73.8% for MCV1 and 38.4% for MCV2. Mixed-effects modeling confirmed a significant negative association between MCV1 coverage and the measles case ratio, while MCV2 coverage did not show a statistically significant independent effect. CONCLUSION: Measles transmission in Nigeria is driven by entrenched hotspots in the north and critical vaccination gaps threatening disease resurgence in the south. Achieving elimination requires a tailored strategy: intensive supplemental immunization activities and RI strengthening aimed at reducing endemic transmission in the northern hotspots, coupled with focused efforts to close routine immunization gaps in specific southern states.

analysis.research_question_and_background: Measles remains a major public health concern in Nigeria, contributing disproportionately to the global burden.
analysis.study_design_and_population: This study conducted a national retrospective ecological analysis integrating 19 years of surveillance data (2006-2025) and geospatial information, with a focused 4-year analysis of vaccination records (2021-2024).
analysis.methods: Analytical methods included time-series decomposition, spatial autocorrelation (Local Moran's I and Getis-Ord Gi*), and linear mixed-effects modeling to quantify vaccination effects while accounting for state-level heterogeneity.
analysis.main_results: Analysis of 253,595 measles cases revealed a highly clustered geographic distribution, with 86.4% of the national burden concentrated in northern Nigeria. Mixed-effects modeling confirmed a significant negative association between MCV1 coverage and the measles case ratio, while MCV2 coverage did not show a statistically significant independent effect.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The study highlights the role of entrenched hotspots in the north and critical vaccination gaps in the south as key drivers of measles transmission, offering a novel perspective on the spatio-temporal dynamics of the disease.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings inform targeted public health interventions, emphasizing the need for intensive supplemental immunization activities and routine immunization strengthening in specific regions to address measles persistence.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its ecological design, which may obscure individual-level factors, and the reliance on aggregated surveillance data, which could introduce bias. The evidence strength is moderate due to these limitations.

The analysis shows a significant negative association between MCV1 coverage and measles case ratios, while MCV2 coverage lacks a statistically significant effect. The study underscores the need for tailored strategies to address endemic transmission in the north and close routine immunization gaps in the south. However, the ecological design and reliance on aggregated data limit the confidence in the findings, resulting in a moderate evidence strength.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 麻疹仍然是尼日利亚的主要公共卫生问题,对全球负担贡献不成比例。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究进行了一项全国性的回顾性生态学分析,整合了19年的监测数据(2006-2025)和地理空间信息,并重点分析了4年的疫苗接种记录(2021-2024)。
elements_zh.methods: 分析方法包括时间序列分解、空间自相关(局部莫兰指数和Getis-Ord Gi*)以及线性混合效应模型,以量化疫苗接种的影响并考虑州级异质性。
elements_zh.main_results: 分析了253,595例麻疹病例,结果显示高度集中的地理分布,全国负担的86.4%集中在尼日利亚北部。我们识别出38个持续存在的热点地方政府区域,占所有病例的23.2%。混合效应模型证实了MCV1覆盖与麻疹病例比率之间存在显著的负相关,而MCV2覆盖则未显示出统计学上显著的独立影响。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 本研究突出了北部固有热点和南部关键疫苗接种缺口在麻疹持续传播中的关键作用,为疾病时空动态提供了新的视角。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果为有针对性的公共卫生干预措施提供了信息,强调需要在特定地区加强密集的补充免疫活动和常规免疫,以应对麻疹的持续传播。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究受到生态学设计的限制,可能掩盖个体层面的因素,且依赖于聚合的监测数据,这可能引入偏差。由于这些限制,证据强度中等。

analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The study highlights the role of entrenched hotspots in the north and critical vaccination gaps in the south as key drivers of measles transmission, offering a novel perspective on the spatio-temporal dynamics of the disease.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings inform targeted public health interventions, emphasizing the need for intensive supplemental immunization activities and routine immunization strengthening in specific regions to address measles persistence.
analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its ecological design, which may obscure individual-level factors, and the reliance on aggregated surveillance data, which could introduce bias. The evidence strength is moderate due to these limitations.

title_zh: 时空动态、传播热点和疫苗接种缺口驱动麻疹在尼日利亚的持续传播,2006-2025年。
source_body_en: BACKGROUND: Measles remains a major public health concern in Nigeria, contributing disproportionately to the global burden. Persistence of the disease is driven by sub-optimal vaccination coverage and heterogeneous transmission patterns, but the specific spatio-temporal dynamics and the quantitative impact of vaccination gaps at the sub-national level are not fully characterized. OBJECTIVE: This study aimed to provide a comprehensive analysis of measles transmission in Nigeria from 2006 to 2025, with the specific objectives to identify spatial hotspots, quantify their temporal persistence, and evaluate the association between MCV1/MCV2 coverage and measles case ratio. METHODS: We conducted a national retrospective ecological study, integrating 19 years of surveillance data (2006-2025) and geospatial information, with a focused 4-year analysis of vaccination records (2021-2024). Analytical methods included time-series decomposition, spatial autocorrelation (Local Moran's I and Getis-Ord Gi*), and linear mixed-effects modeling to quantify vaccination effects while accounting for state-level heterogeneity. RESULTS: Analysis of 253,595 measles cases revealed a highly clustered geographic distribution, with 86.4% of the national burden concentrated in northern Nigeria. We identified 38 persistent hotspot Local Government Areas that accounted for 23.2% of all cases. Vaccination coverage was low and disparate, with national averages of 73.8% for MCV1 and 38.4% for MCV2. Mixed-effects modeling confirmed a significant negative association between MCV1 coverage and the measles case ratio, while MCV2 coverage did not show a statistically significant independent effect. CONCLUSION: Measles transmission in Nigeria is driven by entrenched hotspots in the north and critical vaccination gaps threatening disease resurgence in the south. Achieving elimination requires a tailored strategy: intensive supplemental immunization activities and RI strengthening aimed at reducing endemic transmission in the northern hotspots, coupled with focused efforts to close routine immunization gaps in specific southern states.
abstract_zh: 背景:麻疹仍然是尼日利亚的主要公共卫生问题,对全球负担贡献不成比例。疾病的持续存在受到疫苗接种覆盖率不足和传播模式异质性的影响,但目前尚未完全明确其具体的时空动态以及在次国家层面疫苗接种缺口的定量影响。目的:本研究旨在对尼日利亚2006年至2025年麻疹的传播进行全面分析,具体目标包括识别空间热点、量化其时间持续性,并评估MCV1/MCV2覆盖率与麻疹病例比率之间的关联。方法:我们进行了一项全国范围的回顾性生态学研究,整合了19年的监测数据(2006-2025)和地理空间信息,并重点分析了4年的疫苗接种记录(2021-2024)。分析方法包括时间序列分解、空间自相关(局部莫兰指数和Getis-Ord Gi*)以及线性混合效应模型,以量化疫苗接种的影响并考虑州级异质性。结果:分析了253,595例麻疹病例,发现其地理分布高度聚集,全国负担的86.4%集中在尼日利亚北部。我们识别出38个持续的热点县级行政区,占所有病例的23.2%。疫苗接种覆盖率较低且分布不均,全国平均MCV1覆盖率为73.8%,MCV2覆盖率为38.4%。混合效应模型证实MCV1覆盖率与麻疹病例比率之间存在显著的负相关,而MCV2覆盖率未显示出统计学上显著的独立影响。结论:尼日利亚麻疹的传播主要由北部的顽固热点驱动,并且南部关键的疫苗接种缺口威胁着疾病的再次暴发。实现消除需要采取针对性策略:在北部热点地区开展密集的补充免疫活动并加强常规免疫,以减少地方性传播;同时在特定的南部州集中努力填补常规免疫缺口。

title: Acute measles encephalitis in adults: a case series in Vietnam.
abstract: BACKGROUND: Acute measles encephalitis is a rare but severe complication of measles, particularly in adults, and carries high mortality and a substantial risk of neurological sequelae. Two mechanisms are recognized: direct viral invasion of the brain, termed primary measles encephalitis, and an immune-mediated postinfectious process, termed acute postinfectious measles encephalitis. Most descriptions come from children, and the presentation, pathogenesis, and management of adult disease remain poorly defined. CASE PRESENTATION: We describe four adults (aged 34-45 years) admitted with fever, rash, and altered mental status. Acute measles infection was confirmed by serum measles-specific IgM or measles virus RNA on real-time reverse-transcription PCR. Measles virus RNA was detected in cerebrospinal fluid in Case 1, indicating primary measles encephalitis. Case 2 was initially mistaken for varicella because of an atypical vesicular rash. Case 3 developed quadriparesis and sphincter dysfunction with electromyographic evidence of bilateral S1 radiculopathy; spinal imaging was not performed. Case 4 showed progressive thalamic and temporal lesions on magnetic resonance imaging. Cerebrospinal fluid pleocytosis ranged from 57 to 1046 cells/μL, and improved in most patients within 3 days of intravenous immunoglobulin. Two patients recovered without neurological sequelae, one survived with residual deficits, and one died from persistent cerebral injury complicated by multidrug-resistant septic shock. CONCLUSIONS: In adults, acute measles encephalitis may reflect a biphasic process that combines direct viral neuroinvasion with immune-mediated inflammation, rather than a purely postinfectious phenomenon. Intravenous immunoglobulin was temporally associated with clinical and biochemical improvement, but its therapeutic role cannot be established from a case series and requires controlled study.

analysis.summary_en: This study presents a case series of four adults with acute measles encephalitis in Vietnam, highlighting the severity and neurological complications associated with the disease in adults. The cases demonstrate varied presentations, including primary measles encephalitis and immune-mediated inflammation, with some patients recovering and others experiencing fatal outcomes. The findings underscore the need for better understanding and management of measles encephalitis in adults, as most descriptions of the condition come from pediatric cases. The study's limitations include its observational design, which prevents definitive conclusions about treatment efficacy. The evidence is moderate, as the results are based on clinical observations rather than controlled trials.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 急性麻疹脑炎是麻疹的一种罕见但严重的并发症,尤其在成人中,具有高死亡率和显著的神经后遗症风险。大多数描述来自儿童,而成人疾病的临床表现、发病机制及管理仍不明确。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 我们描述了四名成人(年龄34-45岁),因发热、皮疹和意识状态改变而入院。该研究是在越南进行的病例系列研究。
elements_zh.methods: 急性麻疹感染通过血清麻疹特异性IgM或实时逆转录聚合酶链反应检测到的麻疹病毒 RNA得到确认。脑脊液细胞增多症范围从57到1046个细胞/μL,大多数患者在静脉注射免疫球蛋白治疗3天后有所改善。
elements_zh.main_results: 在病例1中,麻疹病毒 RNA在脑脊液中被检测到,表明为原发性麻疹脑炎。病例4在磁共振成像中显示出进行性丘脑和颞叶病变。两名患者无神经后遗症康复,一名患者存活但遗留部分功能障碍,另一名患者因持续性脑损伤合并多重耐药性败血性休克而死亡。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 在成人中,急性麻疹脑炎可能反映一种双相过程,结合了直接病毒神经侵入和免疫介导的炎症,而不是单纯的感染后现象。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现突显了麻疹病毒在成人中可能导致严重神经并发症的潜力,强调了需要为这一人群改进监测和管理策略。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究受限于病例系列设计,无法确立静脉注射免疫球蛋白的治疗作用。由于研究的观察性质,证据强度中等。

title: Estimating the incidence and duration of diagnostic delays for measles.
abstract: OBJECTIVE: Although measles was declared eliminated in the United States in 2000, cases have increased in recent years. Our goal was to estimate the incidence and duration of diagnostic delays for measles and identify factors associated with delays. DESIGN: Case-crossover. SETTING: We used the Merative MarketScan Research Databases (2001-2023). PATIENTS: We identified measles cases and evaluated prior healthcare encounters for potential missed diagnostic opportunities. METHODS: Using a bootstrapping approach, we estimated the number of healthcare visits representing possible missed opportunities to diagnose measles during a two-week period preceding the index diagnosis. We utilized Firth logistic regression to assess factors associated with delays. RESULTS: We identified 4,651 measles cases. During the two-week period prior to diagnosis, 426 (9.2%) patients had healthcare visits with signs or symptoms commonly associated with measles. We estimated 381 (95%CI: 330-440) missed opportunities to diagnose measles. Delays occurred most frequently in outpatient settings (81.0%). Approximately 6.9% (95%CI: 6.1-8.0%) of patients experienced at least one missed opportunity, with a mean delay of 4.05 days (95%CI: 3.48-4.51) (median delay = 2.94 days [95%CI: 2.00-3.00]). An estimated 1.7% (95%CI: 1.1-2.2%) of patients experienced a diagnostic delay lasting a week or longer. Factors associated with an increased likelihood of delays included age <2 years and receiving antibiotic prescriptions. CONCLUSIONS: Diagnostic delays for measles are not uncommon and may facilitate transmission, especially in outpatient settings.

title: Predictors of severe measles outcomes in hospitalized patients in Jerusalem, 2025.
abstract: OBJECTIVES: Measles is a vaccine-preventable disease. Defining risk factors for poor outcomes in hospitalized patients can improve future measles outbreak preparedness. METHODS: Data were collected on all confirmed measles cases that were evaluated at one of the emergency departments (ED) in the three main hospitals in Jerusalem from the first reported case of the current outbreak on April 10th to December 31st, 2025. Demographic, clinical, and laboratory data were analyzed using robust Poisson multivariable models to calculate incidence rate ratios (IRR) for hospitalization, intensive care unit (ICU) admission, extracorporeal membrane oxygenation (ECMO) and death. RESULTS: Among 786 individuals who visited the ED with confirmed measles, the rates of hospital admission (≥1 day), ICU, ECMO and death were 83.4%, 6.4%, 0.8%, and 1.4%, respectively. Complete data were available for 567 patients, of whom 303 (53.4%) were males. Median age was 2.1 years (IQR 1.2-3.8), and 474 (83.6%) were younger than 5 years. Most patients were unvaccinated (91.0%). Secondary infections were frequent, including lobar pneumonia (28.7%) and community-acquired bacteremia (3.5%). Respiratory support and severe dehydration were associated with hospital admission (IRR 1.4, 95% CI 1.3-1.5; p<0.001 and 9.5, 4.8-18.4; p<0.001, respectively) and ICU admission (IRR 1.3, 1.2-1.4; p<0.001 and 5.2, 2.1-12.4; p<0.001, respectively). Community-acquired bacteremia was associated with death or ECMO (IRR 44.5, 12.5-158.6; p<0.001). CONCLUSIONS: Despite high access to medical care in this urban setting, measles caused substantial morbidity and mortality. Respiratory compromise, severe dehydration, and bacteremia identified patients at increased risk of severe outcomes.

analysis.summary_en: This study aimed to define risk factors for poor outcomes in hospitalized measles patients in Jerusalem, 2025. It analyzed data from confirmed measles cases evaluated at three main hospitals between April 10th and December 31st, 2025. The main results showed that 83.4% of patients were hospitalized, 6.4% required ICU admission, 0.8% needed ECMO, and 1.4% died. Respiratory compromise, severe dehydration, and community-acquired bacteremia were associated with severe outcomes. The findings highlight the importance of identifying risk factors for severe measles outcomes to improve outbreak preparedness and inform targeted interventions. The study used robust statistical methods, providing moderate confidence in its results.

title_zh: 耶路撒冷住院患者中预测严重麻疹结果的指标,2025年。
source_body_en: OBJECTIVES: Measles is a vaccine-preventable disease. Defining risk factors for poor outcomes in hospitalized patients can improve future measles outbreak preparedness. METHODS: Data were collected on all confirmed measles cases that were evaluated at one of the emergency departments (ED) in the three main hospitals in Jerusalem from the first reported case of the current outbreak on April 10th to December 31st, 2025. Demographic, clinical, and laboratory data were analyzed using robust Poisson multivariable models to calculate incidence rate ratios (IRR) for hospitalization, intensive care unit (ICU) admission, extracorporeal membrane oxygenation (ECMO) and death. RESULTS: Among 786 individuals who visited the ED with confirmed measles, the rates of hospital admission (≥1 day), ICU, ECMO and death were 83.4%, 6.4%, 0.8%, and 1.4%, respectively. Complete data were available for 567 patients, of whom 303 (53.4%) were males. Median age was 2.1 years (IQR 1.2-3.8), and 474 (83.6%) were younger than 5 years. Most patients were unvaccinated (91.0%). Secondary infections were frequent, including lobar pneumonia (28.7%) and community-acquired bacteremia (3.5%). Respiratory support and severe dehydration were associated with hospital admission (IRR 1.4, 95% CI 1.3-1.5; p<0.001 and 9.5, 4.8-18.4; p<0.001, respectively) and ICU admission (IRR 1.3, 1.2-1.4; p<0.001 and 5.2, 2.1-12.4; p<0.001, respectively). Community-acquired bacteremia was associated with death or ECMO (IRR 44.5, 12.5-158.6; p<0.001). CONCLUSIONS: Despite high access to medical care in this urban setting, measles caused substantial morbidity and mortality. Respiratory compromise, severe dehydration, and bacteremia identified patients at increased risk of severe outcomes.

title: Post‐Measles Complications and Mortality in Children under Five Years in Low‐ and Middle‐Income Countries: A Narrative Review
abstract: Background: Global measles vaccination programs have achieved significant reductions in measles‐related mortality, with World Health Organization (WHO)‐led initiatives expanding vaccine coverage to over 85% of children worldwide. Despite this progress, measles elimination remains elusive, undermined by anti‐vaccine sentiment, armed conflicts, migration, refugee crises, and post‐COVID‐19 disruptions. No WHO region has achieved or sustained measles elimination status since the COVID‐19 pandemic, and elimination remains challenging in resource‐limited and conflict‐affected contexts. A critical yet underappreciated consequence of this ongoing burden is the rise of post‐measles complications (PMCs). Vaccine‐preventable diseases and malnutrition constitute two critical global health priorities; PMCs represent an important intersection of these agendas that warrant greater attention within the global health framework. Objectives: To review and synthesize current epidemiological evidence on PMCs, examine their pathogenesis, and understand the need for integrated post‐measles care strategies in vulnerable populations. Methods: This narrative review included all papers that published primary data on any of the PMCs in the last 55 years, identified through PubMed and Google Scholar. Findings: Epidemiological data show that 30–40% of measles cases in low‐ and middle‐income countries (LMICs) develop complications, including pneumonia, diarrhea, otitis media, and, less commonly, encephalitis and ocular disease. PMCs are frequently misattributed to independent illnesses because they often emerge after a delay following the acute infection. Compounding this, measles‐induced immune amnesia renders affected individuals vulnerable to secondary infections for up to 2–3 years post‐infection. In LMICs and conflict‐affected settings, this prolonged immunological vulnerability intersects with pre‐existing risk factors such as malnutrition, micronutrient deficiencies, and poor healthcare access, which amplify the consequences substantially. Conclusions: As measles cases resurge globally, the associated burden of PMCs is expected to increase correspondingly. Where PMCs represent a pressing, underaddressed concern, integrated post‐measles care strategies are urgently needed from a global health perspective, especially in resource‐limited and conflict‐affected settings.

title_original: Post‐Measles Complications and Mortality in Children under Five Years in Low‐ and Middle‐Income Countries: A Narrative Review

analysis.scope_and_question: The review focuses on the measles virus, measles disease, and its complications in children under five years in low- and middle-income countries (LMICs). The central question is to examine the epidemiological evidence on post-measles complications (PMCs), their pathogenesis, and the need for integrated post-measles care strategies in vulnerable populations.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: This narrative review included all papers that published primary data on any of the PMCs in the last 55 years, identified through PubMed and Google Scholar. The review does not report a meta-analysis or pooled estimate but synthesizes existing literature to address the research question.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: Epidemiological data show that 30–40% of measles cases in LMICs develop complications, including pneumonia, diarrhea, otitis media, and, less commonly, encephalitis and ocular disease. PMCs are frequently misattributed to independent illnesses because they often emerge after a delay following the acute infection. Measles-induced immune amnesia renders affected individuals vulnerable to secondary infections for up to 2–3 years post-infection. In LMICs and conflict-affected settings, this prolonged immunological vulnerability intersects with pre-existing risk factors such as malnutrition, micronutrient deficiencies, and poor healthcare access, which amplify the consequences substantially.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The review highlights that PMCs are frequently misattributed to independent illnesses due to their delayed onset. Additionally, the review notes that measles elimination remains challenging in resource-limited and conflict-affected contexts, which may contribute to the persistence of PMCs. The evidence does not report specific data on the relative frequency or severity of PMCs across different measles virus genotypes or regions, indicating a gap in understanding the geographic and genetic variability of PMCs.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: Integrated post-measles care strategies are urgently needed from a global health perspective, especially in resource-limited and conflict-affected settings. The review emphasizes the importance of addressing the prolonged immunological vulnerability caused by measles-induced immune amnesia and the need for improved surveillance, diagnosis, and treatment of PMCs in vulnerable populations.

analysis.summary_en: This narrative review examines the epidemiological evidence on post-measles complications (PMCs) in children under five years in low- and middle-income countries (LMICs). It highlights that PMCs, including pneumonia, diarrhea, and otitis media, are a significant consequence of measles infection, often misattributed to other illnesses due to their delayed onset. Measles-induced immune amnesia increases susceptibility to secondary infections for up to 2–3 years post-infection, which is exacerbated by pre-existing risk factors such as malnutrition and poor healthcare access in LMICs. The review underscores the need for integrated post-measles care strategies, especially in resource-limited and conflict-affected settings, as measles cases resurge globally. The evidence does not provide detailed data on the geographic or genetic variability of PMCs, indicating a need for further research.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 本综述聚焦于中麻疹、中麻疹相关疾病及其在低收入和中等收入国家(LMICs)中五岁以下儿童中的并发症。核心问题是探讨中麻疹后并发症(PMCs)的流行病学证据、其发病机制以及在脆弱人群中实施综合的中麻疹后护理策略的必要性。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 本叙述性综述纳入了过去55年间通过PubMed和Google Scholar识别出的所有发表有关任何PMCs原始数据的论文。综述未报告荟萃分析或汇总估计,而是综合现有文献以回答研究问题。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 流行病学数据显示,在低收入和中等收入国家(LMICs)中,30–40%的中麻疹病例会发展为并发症,包括肺炎、腹泻、中耳炎,以及较少见的脑炎和眼部疾病。由于这些并发症通常在急性感染后一段时间才出现,因此常被误认为是独立的疾病。中麻疹引发的免疫记忆丧失使受影响个体在感染后2–3年内更容易受到二次感染。在LMICs和冲突影响的环境中,这种长期的免疫脆弱性与已有的风险因素如营养不良、微量营养素缺乏和医疗资源获取困难相互作用,显著加剧了后果。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 综述指出,由于PMCs的延迟发病,它们常被误认为是独立的疾病。此外,综述还指出,在资源有限和冲突影响的环境中,中麻疹的消除仍面临挑战,这可能与PMCs的持续存在有关。目前的证据并未报告不同中麻疹基因型或地区中PMCs的相对频率或严重程度的具体数据,表明在理解PMCs的地理和遗传变异性方面仍存在知识空白。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 迫切需要从全球卫生角度实施综合的中麻疹后护理策略,尤其是在资源有限和冲突影响的环境中。综述强调了应对中麻疹引发的免疫记忆丧失导致的长期免疫脆弱性的重要性,并指出需要在脆弱人群中改善对PMCs的诊断、监测和治疗。

analysis_en.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The review highlights that PMCs are frequently misattributed to independent illnesses due to their delayed onset. Additionally, the review notes that measles elimination remains challenging in resource-limited and conflict-affected contexts, which may contribute to the persistence of PMCs. The evidence does not report specific data on the relative frequency or severity of PMCs across different measles virus genotypes or regions, indicating a gap in understanding the geographic and genetic variability of PMCs.

title_zh: 五岁以下儿童在低收入和中等收入国家中麻疹后并发症及中麻疹相关疾病:一项叙述性综述
source_body_en: Background: Global measles vaccination programs have achieved significant reductions in measles‐related mortality, with World Health Organization (WHO)‐led initiatives expanding vaccine coverage to over 85% of children worldwide. Despite this progress, measles elimination remains elusive, undermined by anti‐vaccine sentiment, armed conflicts, migration, refugee crises, and post‐COVID‐19 disruptions. No WHO region has achieved or sustained measles elimination status since the COVID‐19 pandemic, and elimination remains challenging in resource‐limited and conflict‐affected contexts. A critical yet underappreciated consequence of this ongoing burden is the rise of post‐measles complications (PMCs). Vaccine‐preventable diseases and malnutrition constitute two critical global health priorities; PMCs represent an important intersection of these agendas that warrant greater attention within the global health framework. Objectives: To review and synthesize current epidemiological evidence on PMCs, examine their pathogenesis, and understand the need for integrated post‐measles care strategies in vulnerable populations. Methods: This narrative review included all papers that published primary data on any of the PMCs in the last 55 years, identified through PubMed and Google Scholar. Findings: Epidemiological data show that 30–40% of measles cases in low‐ and middle‐income countries (LMICs) develop complications, including pneumonia, diarrhea, otitis media, and, less commonly, encephalitis and ocular disease. PMCs are frequently misattributed to independent illnesses because they often emerge after a delay following the acute infection. Compounding this, measles‐induced immune amnesia renders affected individuals vulnerable to secondary infections for up to 2–3 years post‐infection. In LMICs and conflict‐affected settings, this prolonged immunological vulnerability intersects with pre‐existing risk factors such as malnutrition, micronutrient deficiencies, and poor healthcare access, which amplify the consequences substantially. Conclusions: As measles cases resurge globally, the associated burden of PMCs is expected to increase correspondingly. Where PMCs represent a pressing, underaddressed concern, integrated post‐measles care strategies are urgently needed from a global health perspective, especially in resource‐limited and conflict‐affected settings.

analysis_zh.scope_and_question: 本综述聚焦于中麻疹、中麻疹相关疾病及其在低收入和中等收入国家(LMICs)中五岁以下儿童中的并发症。核心问题是探讨中麻疹后并发症(PMCs)的流行病学证据、其发病机制以及在脆弱人群中实施综合的中麻疹后护理策略的必要性。
analysis_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 本叙述性综述纳入了过去55年间通过PubMed和Google Scholar识别出的所有发表有关任何PMCs原始数据的论文。综述未报告荟萃分析或汇总估计,而是综合现有文献以回答研究问题。
analysis_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 流行病学数据显示,在低收入和中等收入国家(LMICs)中,30–40%的中麻疹病例会发展为并发症,包括肺炎、腹泻、中耳炎,以及较少见的脑炎和眼部疾病。由于这些并发症通常在急性感染后一段时间才出现,因此常被误认为是独立的疾病。中麻疹引发的免疫记忆丧失使受影响个体在感染后2–3年内更容易受到二次感染。在LMICs和冲突影响的环境中,这种长期的免疫脆弱性与已有的风险因素如营养不良、微量营养素缺乏和医疗资源获取困难相互作用,显著加剧了后果。
analysis_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 综述指出,由于PMCs的延迟发病,它们常被误认为是独立的疾病。此外,综述还指出,在资源有限和冲突影响的环境中,中麻疹的消除仍面临挑战,这可能与PMCs的持续存在有关。目前的证据并未报告不同中麻疹基因型或地区中PMCs的相对频率或严重程度的具体数据,表明在理解PMCs的地理和遗传变异性方面仍存在知识空白。
analysis_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 迫切需要从全球卫生角度实施综合的中麻疹后护理策略,尤其是在资源有限和冲突影响的环境中。综述强调了应对中麻疹引发的免疫记忆丧失导致的长期免疫脆弱性的重要性,并指出需要在脆弱人群中改善对PMCs的诊断、监测和治疗。

title: Characterizing the relative strength of metapopulation dynamics in measles persistence
abstract: Abstract Background/Aims Measles is a highly infectious, vaccine-preventable disease that remains persistent across much of the world despite continued large-scale control efforts. Local dynamics of measles are shaped by births of susceptible individuals and seasonal drivers of transmission, while broader regional dynamics are shaped by population mobility and metapopulation connectivity. Incidence data, useful for tracking the progress of measles control, are frequently reported only at the aggregate level (e.g., states/provinces), and persistence at this scale may arise because of the independent persistence in all local sub-units or because of regional metapopulation dynamics. Disentangling the contribution of local versus regional persistence is critical in identifying effective strategies for control. Methods/Results We show, as vaccination reduces local measles prevalence, metapopulation colonization and extinction events dominate regional persistence. This manifests as a change in the seasonal distribution of cases throughout the year; incidence becomes more uniformly distributed through the year even with no change in underlying seasonal drivers. We demonstrate this using: 1) a seasonally forced, stochastic metapopulation compartmental model; 2) historical measles incidence in the USA; and 3) recent subnational-level measles incidence in Nigeria. We create a novel, scale-free measure to quantify the contribution of metapopulation dynamics to persistence, roundness, defined as the geometric mean of the scaled maximum and minimum monthly incidence. A low value of roundness indicates strong local persistence dominated by the seasonal attractor, while a high value indicates strong metapopulation persistence. We illustrate the properties of this measure using simulations and observed data. In the USA, roundness nearly doubled after the introduction of the measles-containing vaccine. In Nigeria, roundness is well correlated with observed vaccine coverage, with a Pearson’s r of 0.70 (95% CI: 0.57, 0.80), discriminating between northern states dominated by local persistence of measles and southern states where persistence is maintained by regional dynamics. Conclusion Identifying how measles persists is important in its control—vaccination strategies may differ if persistence is largely local, or if persistence is driven by connectivity from surrounding areas, even where yearly incidence is comparable. Our approach can be valuable areas where other measures (connectivity, mobility, laboratory confirmed illness) are not widely available.

analysis.research_question_and_background: Measles remains persistent globally despite vaccination efforts, highlighting the need to understand the mechanisms driving its persistence.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study uses a metapopulation compartmental model and historical/subnational incidence data from the USA and Nigeria to analyze measles persistence.

analysis.main_results: In the USA, roundness nearly doubled after the introduction of the measles-containing vaccine, and in Nigeria, it is well correlated with vaccine coverage, distinguishing between local and regional persistence.

analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: This measure can inform control strategies by identifying whether persistence is due to local factors or regional connectivity, particularly in areas lacking detailed surveillance data.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the relative role of local and regional dynamics in measles persistence. Using a metapopulation model and incidence data from the USA and Nigeria, the researchers developed a novel measure called roundness to quantify the contribution of metapopulation dynamics. The study highlights the importance of understanding these dynamics for effective control strategies, especially in areas with limited surveillance. However, the reliance on historical data introduces limitations, and the evidence is considered moderate in strength.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to investigate whether the Pennsylvania measles outbreak represents a new normal due to declining vaccine coverage.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study is an observational analysis of measles outbreaks in Pennsylvania and other US states, focusing on trends in vaccine coverage and outbreak patterns.
analysis.methods: The study utilized public health data and surveillance reports to assess measles outbreak trends and vaccine coverage rates across multiple states.
analysis.main_results: The article reports that measles outbreaks in Pennsylvania and other US states have increased in frequency and scale, coinciding with declining vaccine coverage rates.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret these findings as indicative of a potential shift in measles epidemiology, suggesting that the outbreaks may become more common unless vaccination rates improve.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings highlight the importance of maintaining high vaccination rates to prevent the resurgence of measles and inform public health strategies for outbreak control.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is based on observational data and does not include detailed statistical analysis, which limits the strength of the evidence.

analysis.summary_en: This article examines the ongoing measles outbreaks in Pennsylvania and other US states, suggesting that they may represent a new normal due to declining vaccine coverage. The study is observational, relying on public health data to assess trends in outbreak frequency and vaccine rates. It reports an increase in measles outbreaks alongside lower vaccination rates, interpreting this as a potential shift in epidemiology. The findings emphasize the need for sustained vaccination efforts to prevent further outbreaks. However, the study lacks detailed statistical analysis, which limits the strength of its conclusions. The evidence is moderate, as it is based on available surveillance data without experimental validation.

analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将这些发现解释为表明流行病学可能发生转变的迹象,建议除非疫苗接种率得到改善,否则暴发可能会变得更加普遍。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现强调了保持高疫苗接种率以防止麻疹复发的重要性,并为暴发的控制提供了公共卫生策略的依据。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究基于观察性数据,未包含详细的统计分析,这限制了证据的强度。

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study addresses the growing susceptibility to infectious diseases, with a focus on measles virus, as Canada’s loss of measles elimination status serves as a warning.

analysis.methods: The editorial does not describe specific methods or procedures but discusses the context and implications of measles resurgence.
analysis.main_results: The editorial reports that Canada has lost its measles elimination status, indicating a rise in measles cases and susceptibility.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret the loss of measles elimination status as a sign of increasing vulnerability to infectious diseases, emphasizing the need for renewed public health efforts.

analysis.summary_en: This editorial discusses the implications of Canada’s loss of measles elimination status, highlighting the growing susceptibility to infectious diseases. The authors emphasize the need for renewed public health efforts to combat measles resurgence. The study is based on observed trends and does not include detailed methods or statistical analyses. The findings suggest that maintaining measles control measures is critical for public health. The editorial serves as a call to action rather than a data-driven analysis. The evidence is considered to have moderate confidence due to the lack of specific limitations reported.

title: Timeliness of Measles Outbreak Detection, Notification, and Response in Uganda: A 7-1-7 Target Assessment, January–December 2025
abstract: Measles is among the most transmissible human infections, and delays in outbreak detection and response can rapidly amplify community transmission. The 7-1-7 target provides an operational benchmark for evaluating outbreak detection, notification, and early response. We assessed the timeliness of measles outbreak detection, notification, and response in Uganda during 2025 using the 7-1-7 framework to identify opportunities for improving response performance. We assessed 46 laboratory-confirmed measles outbreaks reported in Uganda during 2025 with complete 7-1-7 data. Outbreak timeline data were abstracted from rapid response investigation reports, district records, and laboratory data. Detection (T1) was measured from outbreak emergence to first recording by the surveillance system, notification (T2) from detection to notification of public health authorities, and response (T3) from notification to achievement of the final applicable early response milestone. Timeliness was summarised using medians, IQRs, and proportions meeting each target; new and recurrent outbreaks were compared using Fisher’s exact tests with exact 95% CIs. Qualitative data from 186 District Health Team members were analysed thematically to identify operational bottlenecks and enablers. Among 46 outbreaks, the median detection interval was 16 days (IQR: 8–31), notification interval 1 day (IQR: 0–5), and response interval 34 days (IQR: 22–49). Eight outbreaks (17.4%) met the 7-day detection target, 27 (58.7%) met the 1-day notification target, and two (4.3%) achieved all seven early response milestones within 7 days of notification; none met all three 7-1-7 targets. Detection was supported by effective facility triage, active surveillance, and prior outbreak awareness, while rapid notification was facilitated by mobile-phone communication and accessible surveillance focal persons. Delays were linked to low clinical suspicion, limited community-based surveillance, delayed availability of laboratory confirmation, coordination challenges, and shortages of vaccines, cold-chain equipment, transport, and operational funds. Measles outbreaks in Uganda were generally detected late and responded to slowly, despite comparatively timely notification. Improving performance will require stronger community- and facility-based surveillance, timely laboratory confirmation, functional district coordination structures, and reliable access to vaccines, transport, cold-chain capacity, and operational funding.
journal: Journal of Epidemiology and Global Health

title_zh: 乌干达麻疹 暴发检测、通报和响应的及时性:2025年1月至12月7-1-7目标评估
source_body_en: Measles is among the most transmissible human infections, and delays in outbreak detection and response can rapidly amplify community transmission. The 7-1-7 target provides an operational benchmark for evaluating outbreak detection, notification, and early response. We assessed the timeliness of measles outbreak detection, notification, and response in Uganda during 2025 using the 7-1-7 framework to identify opportunities for improving response performance. We assessed 46 laboratory-confirmed measles outbreaks reported in Uganda during 2025 with complete 7-1-7 data. Outbreak timeline data were abstracted from rapid response investigation reports, district records, and laboratory data. Detection (T1) was measured from outbreak emergence to first recording by the surveillance system, notification (T2) from detection to notification of public health authorities, and response (T3) from notification to achievement of the final applicable early response milestone. Timeliness was summarised using medians, IQRs, and proportions meeting each target; new and recurrent outbreaks were compared using Fisher’s exact tests with exact 95% CIs. Qualitative data from 186 District Health Team members were analysed thematically to identify operational bottlenecks and enablers. Among 46 outbreaks, the median detection interval was 16 days (IQR: 8–31), notification interval 1 day (IQR: 0–5), and response interval 34 days (IQR: 22–49). Eight outbreaks (17.4%) met the 7-day detection target, 27 (58.7%) met the 1-day notification target, and two (4.3%) achieved all seven early response milestones within 7 days of notification; none met all three 7-1-7 targets. Detection was supported by effective facility triage, active surveillance, and prior outbreak awareness, while rapid notification was facilitated by mobile-phone communication and accessible surveillance focal persons. Delays were linked to low clinical suspicion, limited community-based surveillance, delayed availability of laboratory confirmation, coordination challenges, and shortages of vaccines, cold-chain equipment, transport, and operational funds. Measles outbreaks in Uganda were generally detected late and responded to slowly, despite comparatively timely notification. Improving performance will require stronger community- and facility-based surveillance, timely laboratory confirmation, functional district coordination structures, and reliable access to vaccines, transport, cold-chain capacity, and operational funding.
abstract_zh: 麻疹是传播性最强的人类感染之一,暴发的检测和响应延迟会迅速加剧社区传播。7-1-7目标为评估暴发的检测、通报和早期响应提供了操作性基准。我们使用7-1-7框架评估了2025年乌干达报告的46例实验室确认的麻疹 暴发的及时性,以识别改进响应表现的机会。暴发的时间线数据来源于快速响应调查报告、区级记录和实验室数据。检测(T1)是从暴发出现到监测系统首次记录的时间间隔,通报(T2)是从检测到公共卫生当局通报的时间间隔,响应(T3)是从通报到完成最终适用的早期响应里程碑的时间间隔。及时性通过中位数、四分位数范围(IQR)和达到每个目标的比例进行总结;使用Fisher精确检验和精确95%置信区间(CI)比较新发和复发的暴发。对186名区级卫生团队成员的定性数据进行了主题分析,以识别操作瓶颈和促进因素。在46例暴发中,检测间隔的中位数为16天(IQR:8–31),通报间隔为1天(IQR:0–5),响应间隔为34天(IQR:22–49)。8例暴发(17.4%)达到了7天检测目标,27例(58.7%)达到了1天通报目标,2例(4.3%)在通报后7天内完成了所有七个早期响应里程碑;没有案例同时满足三个7-1-7目标。检测得到了有效的设施分诊、主动的监测和先前的暴发意识的支持,而快速通报则得益于手机通讯和可接触的监测联络人。延迟与临床怀疑不足、社区层面的监测有限、实验室确认延迟、协调困难以及疫苗、冷链设备、运输和运营资金短缺有关。尽管通报相对及时,但乌干达的麻疹 暴发总体上仍被较晚地检测到并缓慢地响应。要提高表现,需要加强社区和设施层面的监测,确保及时的实验室确认,建立有效的区级协调结构,并可靠地获得疫苗、运输、冷链能力和运营资金。

title: Measles: The Virus that Makes the Immune System Forget
abstract: Measles remains one of the most contagious viral infections affecting humans and continues to pose a substantial global health threat amid declining vaccination coverage. While its acute clinical manifestations such as fever, respiratory symptoms, conjunctivitis and a characteristic maculopapular rash are well recognized, accumulating evidence demonstrates that measles virus infection induces a profound and prolonged disruption of adaptive immunity termed immune amnesia. This phenomenon results from the viruses preferential infection and depletion of CD150 (a Signaling Lymphocytic Activation Molecule – SLAM family receptor) expressing memory B and T lymphocytes, leading to a measurable loss of previously acquired immune memory from past infections and vaccinations. Immune repertoire sequencing studies have shown that measles infection can eliminate 11%–73% of preexisting antibody diversity in affected children. Epidemiological data further indicate that measles outbreaks are followed by sustained increases in non-measles infectious disease morbidity and mortality for months or even years following recovery. These findings suggest that measles exerts broader immunological and population-level effects than previously appreciated. Vaccination remains the most effective intervention to prevent both acute disease and its long-term immunological sequelae. Strengthening global immunization programs and restoring public confidence in vaccines are therefore critical to mitigating extended public health consequences of measles-induced immune amnesia.
journal: Journal of Medicine, University of Santo Tomas

title_zh: 麻疹:使免疫系统遗忘的病毒
source_body_en: Measles remains one of the most contagious viral infections affecting humans and continues to pose a substantial global health threat amid declining vaccination coverage. While its acute clinical manifestations such as fever, respiratory symptoms, conjunctivitis and a characteristic maculopapular rash are well recognized, accumulating evidence demonstrates that measles virus infection induces a profound and prolonged disruption of adaptive immunity termed immune amnesia. This phenomenon results from the viruses preferential infection and depletion of CD150 (a Signaling Lymphocytic Activation Molecule – SLAM family receptor) expressing memory B and T lymphocytes, leading to a measurable loss of previously acquired immune memory from past infections and vaccinations. Immune repertoire sequencing studies have shown that measles infection can eliminate 11%–73% of preexisting antibody diversity in affected children. Epidemiological data further indicate that measles outbreaks are followed by sustained increases in non-measles infectious disease morbidity and mortality for months or even years following recovery. These findings suggest that measles exerts broader immunological and population-level effects than previously appreciated. Vaccination remains the most effective intervention to prevent both acute disease and its long-term immunological sequelae. Strengthening global immunization programs and restoring public confidence in vaccines are therefore critical to mitigating extended public health consequences of measles-induced immune amnesia.
abstract_zh: 麻疹仍然是影响人类最具有传染性的病毒之一,并且在疫苗接种接种率下降的情况下,继续对全球公共卫生构成重大威胁。尽管其急性临床表现如发热、呼吸道症状、结膜炎和特征性的斑丘疹已广为人知,但越来越多的证据表明,麻疹病毒感染会导致一种深远且持久的适应性免疫系统紊乱,称为免疫遗忘。这一现象源于病毒对表达CD150(一种信号淋巴细胞活化分子——SLAM家族受体)的记忆B细胞和T细胞的优先感染和消耗,从而导致从既往感染和疫苗接种中获得的免疫记忆出现可测量的丧失。免疫谱系测序研究显示,麻疹感染可使受影响儿童的原有抗体多样性减少11%–73%。流行病学数据进一步表明,麻疹 暴发感染后,非麻疹感染性疾病的发病率和死亡率在数月甚至数年后仍持续上升。这些发现表明,麻疹产生的免疫遗忘具有比之前认识更广泛的免疫学和群体层面影响。疫苗接种仍然是预防急性疾病及其长期免疫学后遗症最有效的干预措施。因此,加强全球免疫接种计划并恢复公众对疫苗的信任,对于缓解麻疹诱导的免疫遗忘所带来的长期公共卫生后果至关重要。

title: Burden and clinical characteristics of measles in pre-vaccination age infants
abstract: Background: Measles remains an important cause of childhood morbidity, particularly among infants who are below the routine age for measles-rubella vaccination. These infants may be vulnerable because of declining maternal antibodies and absence of vaccine-derived protection. This study assessed the burden and clinical characteristics of measles among hospitalized children, with particular attention to the pre-vaccination-age group. Methods: This hospital-based cross-sectional study was conducted in the Department of Pediatrics, Mugda Medical College Hospital, Dhaka, from March 2026 to May 2026. A total of 300 children aged 1 month to 12 years admitted to the measles isolation ward were included. Data on demographic characteristics, age, clinical manifestations, complications, management and outcomes were collected using a structured proforma. Measles was diagnosed according to the WHO clinical case definition. Results: Males constituted 61.7% of participants, while 38.3% were female. Infants younger than 1 year represented 57.1% of cases, including 102 (34.0%) infants below 9 months. Fever and rash were present in all patients. Cough, coryza and conjunctivitis were reported in 82.7%, 78.9% and 73.7%, respectively. Pneumonia was the most frequent complication, affecting 63.9% of patients, followed by diarrhea (45.1%) and vomiting (30.1%). All patients received supportive care, while 18.8% required oxygen therapy. ICU admission was required in 0.72% and mortality was 1.0%. Conclusions: Measles caused substantial morbidity among hospitalized children, with pre-vaccination-age infants comprising a considerable proportion of cases. Early recognition, prompt supportive management and strengthened preventive strategies are essential to reduce severe measles-related outcomes.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 麻疹仍然是儿童发病率的重要原因,尤其是在未达常规麻疹-麻疹疫苗接种年龄的婴儿中。这些婴儿可能因母体抗体水平下降和缺乏疫苗来源的保护而更加脆弱。

title: SVIR Model Analysis of Measles with Incomplete Vaccination and 1 Waning Immunity: Sidoarjo-Indonesia Case
abstract: Measles remains a significant public health challenge in Indonesia, especially in regionswith heterogeneous vaccination coverage and waning immunity. This study develops andanalyzes a Susceptible–Vaccinated–Infected–Recovered (SVIR) compartmental model formeasles transmission in Sidoarjo City, Indonesia, incorporating waning immunity. The basicreproduction number R0 is derived using the next-generation matrix method, and the globalstability of both the disease-free and endemic equilibria is rigorously proven via Lyapunovfunctions. Model parameters are estimated from weekly 2023 surveillance data in Sidoarjo Cityusing Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO), Extended Kalman Filter, Maximum LikelihoodEstimation, and Least Squares, and evaluated via Mean Absolute Percentage Error (MAPE).PSO achieves the lowest MAPE (11.17%), outperforming the other methods. The estimatedR0 = 0.668confirms a disease-free regime. Normalized sensitivity analysis identifies vaccineefficacy as the most influential parameter; a decline in efficacy to0 .75elevates R0 close tothe critical threshold, and any further reduction pushes the system into an endemic state.These findings underscore the necessity of maintaining high vaccine efficacy through boosterprograms and strengthened immunization strategies to sustain measles elimination at thedistrict level.
journal: CAUCHY: Jurnal Matematika Murni dan Aplikasi

title_zh: 具有不完整 疫苗接种 和 1 个免疫力减弱的 麻疹 的 SVIR 模型分析:Sidoarjo-Indonesia 案例
source_body_en: Measles remains a significant public health challenge in Indonesia, especially in regionswith heterogeneous vaccination coverage and waning immunity. This study develops andanalyzes a Susceptible–Vaccinated–Infected–Recovered (SVIR) compartmental model formeasles transmission in Sidoarjo City, Indonesia, incorporating waning immunity. The basicreproduction number R0 is derived using the next-generation matrix method, and the globalstability of both the disease-free and endemic equilibria is rigorously proven via Lyapunovfunctions. Model parameters are estimated from weekly 2023 surveillance data in Sidoarjo Cityusing Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO), Extended Kalman Filter, Maximum LikelihoodEstimation, and Least Squares, and evaluated via Mean Absolute Percentage Error (MAPE).PSO achieves the lowest MAPE (11.17%), outperforming the other methods. The estimatedR0 = 0.668confirms a disease-free regime. Normalized sensitivity analysis identifies vaccineefficacy as the most influential parameter; a decline in efficacy to0 .75elevates R0 close tothe critical threshold, and any further reduction pushes the system into an endemic state.These findings underscore the necessity of maintaining high vaccine efficacy through boosterprograms and strengthened immunization strategies to sustain measles elimination at thedistrict level.
abstract_zh: 麻疹仍然是印度尼西亚的重大公共卫生挑战,尤其是在疫苗接种覆盖率异质性和免疫力下降的地区。本研究开发并分析了一个针对麻疹传播的易感-接种-感染-康复(SVIR)分组模型,该模型纳入了免疫力下降的因素。基本再生数R0是通过下一代矩阵方法推导的,并且通过李雅普诺夫函数严格证明了无病平衡态和地方性平衡态的全局稳定性。模型参数是从2023年Sidoarjo市每周的监测数据中使用粒子群优化(PSO)、扩展卡尔曼滤波、最大似然估计和最小二乘法进行估计,并通过平均绝对百分比误差(MAPE)进行评估。PSO方法实现了最低的MAPE(11.17%),优于其他方法。估计的R0 = 0.668确认了无病状态。归一化敏感性分析确定疫苗效力是最关键的参数;疫苗效力下降至0 .75会使R0接近临界阈值,任何进一步的减少都会使系统进入地方性状态。这些发现强调了通过加强剂接种计划和强化疫苗接种策略保持高疫苗效力的必要性,以在区级维持麻疹的消除。

title: Measles-Specific IgG Antibody Levels and Associated Demographic and Vaccination Factors Among Children in Diyala Governorate, Iraq: A Cross-Sectional Study
abstract: Measles is a significant cause of death in children, despite the availability of safe and cost-effective measles vaccines. Monitoring measles-specific IgG antibody levels is essential for evaluating vaccine-induced immunity and identifying factors associated with protective immune responses. This study was aimed to assess of measles IgG antibody levels and identify associated factors affecting measles immunity among children in Diyala Governorate / Iraq. A cross-sectional study was conducted between October 1, 2025, and April 30, 2026. Ninety children aged 1–14 years who had received at least one dose of a measles-containing vaccine were enrolled from primary health care centres in Diyala Governorate. Venous blood samples were collected, and serum anti-measles IgG antibody concentrations were determined using the enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay (ELISA). Demographic characteristics and vaccination history were obtained through a structured questionnaire. Statistical analysis was performed using SPSS version 29, with statistical significance set at P < 0.05 Among the 90 enrolled children, 53.3% were males and 46.7% were females. Female children showed significantly higher measles IgG antibody concentrations than males (64.74 ± 58.91 vs. 46.60 ± 46.55 ng/L; P = 0.006). No significant differences in measles IgG antibody concentrations were observed according to vaccination status (65.77 ± 73.29 vs. 50.48 ± 41.64 ng/L; P = 0.682) or age groups (P = 0.341). Furthermore, a weak positive correlation was found between measles IgG antibody concentration and the number of vaccine doses; however, this correlation was not statistically significant (r = 0.070, P = 0.512).

title_zh: 麻疹特异性IgG抗体水平及其相关的流行病学和疫苗接种因素在伊拉克迪亚拉省儿童中的研究:一项横断面研究
source_body_en: Measles is a significant cause of death in children, despite the availability of safe and cost-effective measles vaccines. Monitoring measles-specific IgG antibody levels is essential for evaluating vaccine-induced immunity and identifying factors associated with protective immune responses. This study was aimed to assess of measles IgG antibody levels and identify associated factors affecting measles immunity among children in Diyala Governorate / Iraq. A cross-sectional study was conducted between October 1, 2025, and April 30, 2026. Ninety children aged 1–14 years who had received at least one dose of a measles-containing vaccine were enrolled from primary health care centres in Diyala Governorate. Venous blood samples were collected, and serum anti-measles IgG antibody concentrations were determined using the enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay (ELISA). Demographic characteristics and vaccination history were obtained through a structured questionnaire. Statistical analysis was performed using SPSS version 29, with statistical significance set at P < 0.05 Among the 90 enrolled children, 53.3% were males and 46.7% were females. Female children showed significantly higher measles IgG antibody concentrations than males (64.74 ± 58.91 vs. 46.60 ± 46.55 ng/L; P = 0.006). No significant differences in measles IgG antibody concentrations were observed according to vaccination status (65.77 ± 73.29 vs. 50.48 ± 41.64 ng/L; P = 0.682) or age groups (P = 0.341). Furthermore, a weak positive correlation was found between measles IgG antibody concentration and the number of vaccine doses; however, this correlation was not statistically significant (r = 0.070, P = 0.512).

title: Development of a New Lyophilized Live-Attenuated Measles–Rubella (MR) Vaccine Formulation Designed for Lower-Cost Production in Africa
abstract: Background/Objectives: This work describes the development of a new, lyophilized, live-attenuated measles–rubella (MR) vaccine formulation designed for lower-cost production in Africa. The formulation consists of a stabilizer solution (containing only non-animal-derived excipients) and high-titer MR viral bulks (produced in MRC-5 cells by a modernized process) prepared at a ratio of 95% and 5% (v/v), respectively. Methods: Both lab-scale and pilot-scale freeze-drying cycles were developed, a high-throughput RT-qPCR-based viral infectivity assay was implemented, and effective excipient screening conditions to identify stabilizing additives for MR viruses were employed. Based on the down-selected hits, candidate lyophilized MR formulations were designed, prepared, and evaluated by comparative storage stability assessments. Results: First, protein-based bulking agents (used in many commercial lyophilized MR-containing vaccines) were avoided in favor of sucrose/mannitol mixtures. Second, ~50 excipients were screened, and two additional key stabilizing components were identified (both previously reported to stabilize MR viruses): sodium phosphate buffer and urea. Next, stability assessments were performed on different variations of a candidate lyophilized MR formulation to elucidate the inter-relationships between sucrose–mannitol ratios, cake integrity, and MR virus stability. An optimized MR vaccine formulation composition (post-reconstitution) of 5% (w/v) mannitol, 5% (w/v) sucrose, 50 mM urea, 25 mM sodium phosphate buffer (pH 6.5), and 5% (v/v) viral bulks was established. When this formulation was lyophilized at lab-scale in a single-dose format, both MR viruses displayed promising stability profiles during storage under real-time and accelerated conditions. A five-dose format was then evaluated in a pilot-scale freeze-dryer by using a 2X formulation filled into larger vials, lyophilized, and then reconstituted to 1X concentration. Conclusions: Results demonstrated the feasibility of a new, lower-cost, lyophilized, multidose MR formulation for potential use with a live-attenuated MR vaccine candidate targeted for local production in Africa.

analysis.summary_en: This study aimed to develop a new, lyophilized, live-attenuated measles–rubella (MR) vaccine formulation designed for lower-cost production in Africa. The formulation was created using non-animal-derived excipients and high-titer MR viral bulks produced in MRC-5 cells. Lab-scale and pilot-scale freeze-drying cycles were developed, and a high-throughput RT-qPCR-based viral infectivity assay was used to evaluate stability. The results showed that sucrose/mannitol mixtures were preferred over protein-based bulking agents, and two key stabilizing components—sodium phosphate buffer and urea—were identified. Stability assessments revealed promising profiles for the optimized formulation under real-time and accelerated storage conditions. The findings suggest the feasibility of a lower-cost, multidose MR vaccine for local production in Africa, which could enhance immunization programs. However, the study is limited to abstract-only evidence, and the results are based on controlled conditions, which may not fully reflect real-world applications. The evidence strength is moderate.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在开发一种新型、冻干、减毒麻疹–麻疹(MR)疫苗制剂,以实现非洲低成本生产,解决资源匮乏地区对经济且稳定的疫苗的需求。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究涉及一种冻干MR 疫苗制剂的实验室规模和中试规模冻干循环的开发,研究对象包括在MRC-5细胞中生产的病毒制剂,并在不同条件下评估其稳定性。
elements_zh.methods: 开发了实验室规模和中试规模的冻干循环,实施了高通量RT-qPCR为基础的病毒感染力检测,并采用了有效的赋形剂筛选条件以确定MR病毒的稳定添加剂。
elements_zh.main_results: 首先,避免使用基于蛋白质的填充剂(许多商业冻干MR制剂中使用),而采用蔗糖/甘露醇混合物。其次,筛选了约50种赋形剂,并确定了两种额外的关键稳定成分:磷酸钠缓冲液和尿素。对候选冻干MR制剂的不同变种进行了稳定性评估,以阐明蔗糖–甘露醇比例、冻干块完整性与MR病毒稳定性之间的相互关系。

analysis_en.study_design_and_population: The study involved the development of lab-scale and pilot-scale freeze-drying cycles for a lyophilized MR vaccine formulation, with the population consisting of viral bulks produced in MRC-5 cells and evaluated for stability under various conditions.
analysis_en.methods: Both lab-scale and pilot-scale freeze-drying cycles were developed, a high-throughput RT-qPCR-based viral infectivity assay was implemented, and effective excipient screening conditions were employed to identify stabilizing additives for MR viruses.

title_zh: 一种新型冻干减毒麻疹–麻疹(MR)疫苗制剂的开发,旨在实现非洲低成本生产
source_body_en: Background/Objectives: This work describes the development of a new, lyophilized, live-attenuated measles–rubella (MR) vaccine formulation designed for lower-cost production in Africa. The formulation consists of a stabilizer solution (containing only non-animal-derived excipients) and high-titer MR viral bulks (produced in MRC-5 cells by a modernized process) prepared at a ratio of 95% and 5% (v/v), respectively. Methods: Both lab-scale and pilot-scale freeze-drying cycles were developed, a high-throughput RT-qPCR-based viral infectivity assay was implemented, and effective excipient screening conditions to identify stabilizing additives for MR viruses were employed. Based on the down-selected hits, candidate lyophilized MR formulations were designed, prepared, and evaluated by comparative storage stability assessments. Results: First, protein-based bulking agents (used in many commercial lyophilized MR-containing vaccines) were avoided in favor of sucrose/mannitol mixtures. Second, ~50 excipients were screened, and two additional key stabilizing components were identified (both previously reported to stabilize MR viruses): sodium phosphate buffer and urea. Next, stability assessments were performed on different variations of a candidate lyophilized MR formulation to elucidate the inter-relationships between sucrose–mannitol ratios, cake integrity, and MR virus stability. An optimized MR vaccine formulation composition (post-reconstitution) of 5% (w/v) mannitol, 5% (w/v) sucrose, 50 mM urea, 25 mM sodium phosphate buffer (pH 6.5), and 5% (v/v) viral bulks was established. When this formulation was lyophilized at lab-scale in a single-dose format, both MR viruses displayed promising stability profiles during storage under real-time and accelerated conditions. A five-dose format was then evaluated in a pilot-scale freeze-dryer by using a 2X formulation filled into larger vials, lyophilized, and then reconstituted to 1X concentration. Conclusions: Results demonstrated the feasibility of a new, lower-cost, lyophilized, multidose MR formulation for potential use with a live-attenuated MR vaccine candidate targeted for local production in Africa.
abstract_zh: 背景/目标:本研究描述了一种新型、冻干、减毒麻疹–麻疹(MR)疫苗制剂的开发,旨在实现非洲低成本生产。该制剂由稳定剂溶液(仅含非动物来源的赋形剂)和高滴度的MR病毒制剂(通过现代化工艺在MRC-5细胞中生产)组成,比例分别为95%和5%(体积比)。方法:开发了实验室规模和中试规模的冻干循环,实施了高通量RT-qPCR为基础的病毒感染力检测,并采用了有效的赋形剂筛选条件以确定MR病毒的稳定添加剂。基于筛选结果,设计、制备并评估了候选冻干MR制剂,通过比较储存稳定性评估。结果:首先,避免使用基于蛋白质的填充剂(许多商业冻干MR制剂中使用),而采用蔗糖/甘露醇混合物。其次,筛选了约50种赋形剂,并确定了两种额外的关键稳定成分(此前均被报道可稳定MR病毒):磷酸钠缓冲液和尿素。随后,对候选冻干MR制剂的不同变种进行了稳定性评估,以阐明蔗糖–甘露醇比例、冻干块完整性与MR病毒稳定性之间的相互关系。最终确定了优化后的MR 疫苗制剂配方(复溶后):5%(重量/体积)甘露醇、5%(重量/体积)蔗糖、50 mM尿素、25 mM磷酸钠缓冲液(pH 6.5)以及5%(体积/体积)病毒制剂。当该制剂以单剂量形式在实验室规模冻干时,两种MR病毒在实时和加速储存条件下均表现出良好的稳定性。随后,在中试规模冻干机中评估了五剂量形式,采用2倍浓度的制剂填充到更大的安瓿中,冻干后复溶至1倍浓度。结论:结果表明,一种新型、低成本、冻干、多剂量的MR制剂在非洲本地生产减毒MR 疫苗候选疫苗的潜在应用中是可行的。研究结果可为开发更经济且稳定的MR 疫苗提供依据,从而改善非洲的免疫接种计划和疾病预防工作。局限性与证据强度:本研究仅基于摘要证据,结果基于受控条件下的稳定性评估,可能无法完全反映现实世界的情况。证据强度为中等。
