title: Socioeconomic Determinants of Measles Incidence, Outbreaks, and Vaccination Non-Completion Among Children Under Five in Southeast Asia: A Systematic Review
abstract: This systematic review investigates the relationship between socioeconomic status (SES) and measles incidence, outbreaks, transmission, and routine immunization non-completion among children under five years of age in Southeast Asia. While global literature documents general disparities in childhood vaccination, significant research gaps remain regarding how context-specific parental factors—specifically household income, parental education, maternal literacy, and employment status—interact with structural healthcare access to drive pediatric disease susceptibility. By systematically synthesizing empirical quantitative observational studies (cross-sectional, cohort, case-control, and ecological) published in English between 2016 and 2025, this project aims to isolate the primary socioeconomic determinants influencing measles infection and incomplete vaccination within Southeast Asian countries like Malaysia, Indonesia, Thailand, the Philippines, and Vietnam. Ultimately, the expected outcomes will yield empirical, context-specific evidence to help public health policymakers design targeted equity interventions, strengthen routine immunization coverage, and prevent measles outbreaks across vulnerable pediatric populations.
authors: NIK FARESHA SOFEA BINTI FARIQ IDZHAR

abstract_zh: 本系统综述探讨了社会经济地位(SES)与东南亚5岁以下儿童麻疹 发病率、暴发、传播以及常规免疫接种未完成之间的关系。尽管全球文献记录了儿童疫苗接种的一般差异,但关于特定情境下的父母因素——特别是家庭收入、父母教育水平、母亲识字率和就业状况——如何与结构性医疗保健获取相互作用以驱动儿童疾病易感性的研究仍存在重大空白。通过系统地综合2016年至2025年间发表的英文实证定量观察性研究(横断面、队列研究、病例对照和生态研究),本项目旨在识别影响东南亚国家(如马来西亚、印度尼西亚、泰国、菲律宾和越南)中麻疹感染和不完全疫苗接种的主要社会经济决定因素。最终,预期结果将产生实证且情境特定的证据,以帮助公共卫生政策制定者设计有针对性的公平干预措施,加强常规免疫接种覆盖率,并预防麻疹 暴发在易感儿童群体中的传播。

title: Factors Associated with Length of Hospital Stay and Clinical Characteristics of Children Hospitalized with Measles
abstract: Objective: To evaluate the clinical characteristics, complications, and factors associated with the length of hospital stay in children hospitalized with measles. Materials and Methods: This retrospective, observational study included children aged 0-18 years hospitalized with measles between January and December 2023 at a tertiary care center in Istanbul, Türkiye. Demographic, clinical, laboratory, and hospitalization data were analyzed. Results: Sixty-one hospitalized children with measles were included; 32 (52.5%) were younger than 5 years and 29 (47.5%) were older than 5 years. Fifty-nine percent were Turkish citizens, 41% were foreign nationals, and 57.4% were male. Overall, 77% were unvaccinated. Fever and rash were present in all patients. Pneumonia was the most common complication (68.9%), followed by hepatitis (11.5%), gingivostomatitis (11.5%), ocular complications (9.8%), and otitis (4.9%). All hepatitis cases occurred in children older than 5 years. Three patients (5.2%) required pediatric intensive care. In univariable linear regression analyses, pneumonia/bronchopneumonia, C-reactive protein (CRP), and white blood cell count were significantly associated with longer hospital stay. In the primary multivariable linear regression model, only CRP remained independently associated with prolonged hospitalization (B = 0.017, 95% CI = 0.0002-0.0333; P = .047). No measles-related deaths occurred. Conclusion: Measles remains a major public health problem, particularly among unvaccinated children. Inflammatory markers were associated with prolonged hospitalization, suggesting that systemic inflammation may contribute to longer inpatient care. Larger multicenter studies are needed to confirm these findings.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 评估住院治疗的麻疹患儿的临床特征、并发症及与住院时间相关的因素。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究为回顾性观察性研究,纳入了2023年1月至12月期间在土耳其伊斯坦布尔一家三级医疗机构住院治疗的0-18岁麻疹患儿。
elements_zh.methods: 分析了人口学、临床、实验室及住院数据。
elements_zh.main_results: 共纳入61例住院治疗的麻疹患儿;其中52.5%年龄小于5岁,47.5%年龄大于5岁,59%为土耳其公民,41%为外国国籍,57.4%为男性,77%未接种疫苗。所有患者均出现发热和皮疹。最常见的并发症为肺炎(68.9%),其次是肝炎(11.5%)、牙龈口炎(11.5%)、眼部并发症(9.8%)和中耳炎(4.9%)。所有肝炎病例均发生于年龄大于5岁的患儿中。3例患儿(5.2%)需要儿科重症监护。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: In univariable linear regression analyses, pneumonia/bronchopneumonia, C-reactive protein (CRP), and white blood cell count were significantly associated with longer hospital stay. In the primary multivariable linear regression model, only CRP remained independently associated with prolonged hospitalization (B = 0.017, 95% CI = 0.0002-0.0333; P = .047). Inflammatory markers were associated with prolonged hospitalization, suggesting that systemic inflammation may contribute to longer inpatient care.
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 麻疹仍然是一个重要的公共卫生问题,尤其是在未接种疫苗的儿童中。需要更大规模的多中心研究来验证这些发现。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究的局限性在于其回顾性设计,需要更大规模的多中心研究来验证这些发现。样本量相对较小,且研究仅在单一中心进行,这可能限制其结果的普遍适用性。

analysis_zh.main_results: 共纳入61例住院治疗的麻疹患儿;其中52.5%年龄小于5岁,47.5%年龄大于5岁,59%为土耳其公民,41%为外国国籍,57.4%为男性,77%未接种疫苗。所有患者均出现发热和皮疹。最常见的并发症为肺炎(68.9%),其次是肝炎(11.5%)、牙龈口炎(11.5%)、眼部并发症(9.8%)和中耳炎(4.9%)。所有肝炎病例均发生于年龄大于5岁的患儿中。3例患儿(5.2%)需要儿科重症监护。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 麻疹仍然是一个重要的公共卫生问题,尤其是在未接种疫苗的儿童中。需要更大规模的多中心研究来验证这些发现。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究的局限性在于其回顾性设计,需要更大规模的多中心研究来验证这些发现。样本量相对较小,且研究仅在单一中心进行,这可能限制其结果的普遍适用性。

title: Estimating measles vaccine effectiveness from Japanese public surveillance data with quantitative bias analysis: study protocol and statistical analysis plan (version 2.4)
abstract: Japan began national measles case-based surveillance in 2008 and was verified as having eliminated endemic transmission in 2015, yet importation-related clusters continue and global resurgence has renewed attention. In an elimination setting, vaccine effectiveness estimation is limited both by small case numbers and by mismatch between where cases arise and whom the reference survey represents. This study estimates VE by the screening method from published Japanese aggregate data, contrasting one or more doses against none, primarily in children aged 2-4 across three periods (2008-2014, 2015-2019, 2020-2025), with calendar year adjusted within period by a two-group binomial likelihood and 95 percent profile-likelihood intervals. Ages 5-19 are reported as important secondary results. The distinguishing feature is that quantitative bias analysis is treated as a co-equal part of the result rather than an appendix: missingness in vaccination history is modelled explicitly through the completed vaccination share, with the share among those of unknown status set both as a MAR-equivalent state and at fixed absolute values; selection mismatch between the reference sample and the case-generating population enters as an independently fixed multiplier K; and residual confounding together with differential case ascertainment enters as a multiplier B for the extension to clinical VE. Case counts by age and vaccination history exist only inside published bar charts and were recovered by two independent extractors from PDF vector coordinates, enumerating all integer candidates within a fixed tolerance and reconciling disagreements against the original sources. Coverage of the interval method was verified on synthetic data before the data-dependent steps, and flagged under-coverage in three conditions led to a registered interpretation rule rather than a change of method. No real-data VE has been computed at the time of registration; the information already viewed is enumerated rather than claimed absent. The protocol states in advance that a sensitivity range crossing zero is part of the intended finding about the limits of conditional inference, and is not evidence that the vaccine is ineffective.

analysis.research_question_and_background: This study aims to estimate measles vaccine effectiveness (VE) in Japan using public surveillance data, addressing the challenge of accurately assessing VE in an elimination setting where case numbers are small and reference populations may not align with case-generating populations.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study is a protocol for estimating VE using Japanese public surveillance data, focusing on measles cases and vaccination history across three time periods (2008-2014, 2015-2019, 2020-2025), primarily in children aged 2-4 years.
analysis.methods: The study employs a screening method to estimate VE from published Japanese aggregate data, comparing one or more doses of measles vaccine against none, using a two-group binomial likelihood model with calendar year adjustments and 95 percent profile-likelihood intervals.
analysis.main_results: The main results include VE estimates for children aged 2-4 years, with secondary results reported for ages 5-19 years.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret the findings as highlighting the limitations of conditional inference in VE estimation, emphasizing that a sensitivity range crossing zero does not imply vaccine ineffectiveness but rather reflects methodological constraints.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings can inform surveillance strategies and the interpretation of VE in elimination settings, contributing to improved understanding of vaccine performance and potential biases in data collection.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study acknowledges limitations such as missing vaccination data and potential selection mismatch, but the evidence strength is considered moderate due to the use of synthetic data verification and a registered interpretation rule.

analysis.summary_en: This study outlines a protocol for estimating measles vaccine effectiveness (VE) in Japan using public surveillance data. It addresses the challenge of VE estimation in an elimination setting, where small case numbers and mismatch between case-generating populations and reference samples limit accuracy. The methods involve a screening approach using a two-group binomial likelihood model with calendar year adjustments and 95 percent profile-likelihood intervals. The main results include VE estimates for children aged 2-4 years, with secondary results for ages 5-19 years. The authors interpret these findings as demonstrating the limitations of conditional inference, noting that a sensitivity range crossing zero does not indicate vaccine ineffectiveness. The study's implications for public health include informing surveillance strategies and improving the interpretation of VE in elimination contexts. The evidence strength is moderate, as the study accounts for biases through quantitative bias analysis and synthetic data verification, but it does not yet present real-data VE estimates.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在利用日本公开的监测数据,估计麻疹 疫苗的效果(VE),解决在消除背景下准确评估VE的挑战,其中病例数量较少且参考人群可能与病例产生人群不一致。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究是一项利用日本公开的监测数据估计VE的方案,重点关注麻疹病例和疫苗接种历史,涵盖三个时间段(2008-2014年、2015-2019年、2020-2025年),主要针对2-4岁儿童。
elements_zh.methods: 该研究采用筛选方法,从已发表的日本汇总数据中估计VE,将一个或多个剂量的麻疹与未接种的疫苗进行比较,使用带有日历年调整的两组二项式似然模型和95百分比轮廓似然区间。
elements_zh.main_results: 主要结果包括2-4岁儿童的VE估计,5-19岁年龄段的VE被报告为次要结果。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将研究结果解释为强调在VE估计中条件推断的局限性,指出敏感性范围跨越零并不意味着疫苗无效,而是反映了方法上的限制。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可以为监测策略提供信息,并有助于理解消除背景下VE的评估,从而提高对疫苗表现和数据收集潜在偏倚的认识。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究承认了一些局限性,如疫苗接种数据的缺失和潜在的选择偏差,但由于使用了合成数据验证和注册的解释规则,证据强度被认为是中等的。

analysis_en.research_question_and_background: This study aims to estimate measles vaccine effectiveness (VE) in Japan using public surveillance data, addressing the challenge of accurately assessing VE in an elimination setting where case numbers are small and reference populations may not align with case-generating populations.
analysis_en.study_design_and_population: The study is a protocol for estimating VE using Japanese public surveillance data, focusing on measles cases and vaccination history across three time periods (2008-2014, 2015-2019, 2020-2025), primarily in children aged 2-4 years.
analysis_en.methods: The study employs a screening method to estimate VE from published Japanese aggregate data, comparing one or more doses of measles vaccine against none, using a two-group binomial likelihood model with calendar year adjustments and 95 percent profile-likelihood intervals.
analysis_en.main_results: The main results include VE estimates for children aged 2-4 years, with secondary results reported for ages 5-19 years.
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret the findings as highlighting the limitations of conditional inference in VE estimation, emphasizing that a sensitivity range crossing zero does not imply vaccine ineffectiveness but rather reflects methodological constraints.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings can inform surveillance strategies and the interpretation of VE in elimination settings, contributing to improved understanding of vaccine performance and potential biases in data collection.
analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study acknowledges limitations such as missing vaccination data and potential selection mismatch, but the evidence strength is considered moderate due to the use of synthetic data verification and a registered interpretation rule.

title_zh: 从日本公开的监测数据中通过定量偏倚分析估计麻疹 疫苗效果:研究方案和统计分析计划(版本2.4)
source_body_en: Japan began national measles case-based surveillance in 2008 and was verified as having eliminated endemic transmission in 2015, yet importation-related clusters continue and global resurgence has renewed attention. In an elimination setting, vaccine effectiveness estimation is limited both by small case numbers and by mismatch between where cases arise and whom the reference survey represents. This study estimates VE by the screening method from published Japanese aggregate data, contrasting one or more doses against none, primarily in children aged 2-4 across three periods (2008-2014, 2015-2019, 2020-2025), with calendar year adjusted within period by a two-group binomial likelihood and 95 percent profile-likelihood intervals. Ages 5-19 are reported as important secondary results. The distinguishing feature is that quantitative bias analysis is treated as a co-equal part of the result rather than an appendix: missingness in vaccination history is modelled explicitly through the completed vaccination share, with the share among those of unknown status set both as a MAR-equivalent state and at fixed absolute values; selection mismatch between the reference sample and the case-generating population enters as an independently fixed multiplier K; and residual confounding together with differential case ascertainment enters as a multiplier B for the extension to clinical VE. Case counts by age and vaccination history exist only inside published bar charts and were recovered by two independent extractors from PDF vector coordinates, enumerating all integer candidates within a fixed tolerance and reconciling disagreements against the original sources. Coverage of the interval method was verified on synthetic data before the data-dependent steps, and flagged under-coverage in three conditions led to a registered interpretation rule rather than a change of method. No real-data VE has been computed at the time of registration; the information already viewed is enumerated rather than claimed absent. The protocol states in advance that a sensitivity range crossing zero is part of the intended finding about the limits of conditional inference, and is not evidence that the vaccine is ineffective.

title: Laporan Kasus: Campak (Measles) pada Anak
abstract: Campak (measles) merupakan penyakit infeksi virus akut yang sangat menular dan masih menjadi masalah kesehatan masyarakat, terutama pada anak-anak. Penyakit ini dapat menyebabkan berbagai komplikasi akibat penurunan sistem imun sementara. Tujuan laporan kasus ini adalah untuk menggambarkan manifestasi klinis, penegakan diagnosis, serta tatalaksana pada pasien campak. Laporan ini merupakan studi deskriptif dengan desain laporan kasus pada seorang anak laki-laki usia 3 tahun 9 bulan yang datang dengan keluhan demam selama 7 hari disertai batuk, pilek, konjungtivitis, serta ruam makulopapular yang menyebar dari belakang telinga ke seluruh tubuh. Pada pemeriksaan fisik ditemukan bercak Koplik pada mukosa bukal. Pemeriksaan laboratorium menunjukkan leukopenia dengan limfositosis relatif. Manifestasi klinis pasien sesuai dengan gambaran khas campak. Pasien mendapatkan tatalaksana suportif berupa cairan intravena, antipiretik, antiemetik, serta vitamin A dosis tinggi, dan menunjukkan perbaikan klinis selama perawatan. Diagnosis campak dapat ditegakkan secara klinis berdasarkan gejala khas dan tanda patognomonik, serta tatalaksana suportif yang adekuat memberikan hasil yang baik dalam perbaikan kondisi pasien.

Penyakit ini dapat menyebabkan berbagai komplikasi akibat penurunan sistem imun sementara. Tujuan laporan kasus ini adalah untuk menggambarkan manifestasi klinis, penegakan diagnosis, serta tatalaksana pada pasien campak. Laporan ini merupakan studi deskriptif dengan desain laporan kasus pada seorang anak laki-laki usia 3 tahun 9 bulan yang datang dengan keluhan demam selama 7 hari disertai batuk, pilek, konjungtivitis, serta ruam makulopapular yang menyebar dari belakang telinga ke seluruh tubuh. Pada pemeriksaan fisik ditemukan bercak Koplik pada mukosa bukal. Pemeriksaan laboratorium menunjukkan leukopenia dengan limfositosis relatif. Manifestasi klinis pasien sesuai dengan gambaran khas campak. Pasien mendapatkan tatalaksana suportif berupa cairan intravena, antipiretik, antiemetik, serta vitamin A dosis tinggi, dan menunjukkan perbaikan klinis selama perawatan. Diagnosis campak dapat ditegakkan secara klinis berdasarkan gejala khas dan tanda patognomonik, serta tatalaksana suportif yang adekuat memberikan hasil yang baik dalam perbaikan kondisi pasien.

analysis.research_question_and_background: Campak (measles) remains a major public-health problem in children, and this case report was needed to document clinical presentation, diagnosis, and management in a single pediatric patient.
analysis.study_design_and_population: This is a descriptive case-report study of one 3-year-old boy presenting with fever for seven days, cough, rhinorrhea, conjunctivitis, and a maculopapular rash spreading from the retroauricular region to the whole body.
analysis.methods: The report describes clinical observation, physical examination including Koplik spots on buccal mucosa, laboratory findings of leukopenia with relative lymphocytosis, and supportive management with intravenous fluids, antipyretics, antiemetics, and high-dose vitamin A.
analysis.main_results: Physical examination revealed Koplik spots on buccal mucosa; laboratory tests showed leukopenia with relative lymphocytosis; the patient received supportive care and showed clinical improvement during treatment.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret Koplik spots as a pathognomonic sign supporting clinical diagnosis of measles, and they conclude that adequate supportive therapy yields favorable clinical outcomes.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: Clinical diagnosis based on characteristic signs and Koplik spots can suffice for measles confirmation, and supportive care including high-dose vitamin A contributes to favorable recovery.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: This is an abstract-only report from a single pediatric case, so the evidence is limited to one patient and cannot establish prevalence, causality, or generalizability beyond the described case.

analysis.summary_en: Measles remains a major public-health problem in children, and this case report documents clinical presentation, diagnosis, and management in a single 3-year-old boy with Koplik spots, leukopenia with relative lymphocytosis, and favorable response to supportive care including high-dose vitamin A.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 麻疹(麻疹)仍然是儿童公共卫生问题,因此需要进行这项病例报告以记录单一儿科病例的临床表现、诊断(诊断)及治疗措施。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究是一项描述性病例报告研究,针对一名3岁9个月的男童,其主诉为持续7天的发热,伴有咳嗽、流涕、结膜炎以及从耳后蔓延至全身的斑丘疹。
elements_zh.methods: 本报告描述了临床观察、体格检查(包括口腔黏膜上的Koplik斑)、实验室检查结果(白细胞减少伴相对淋巴细胞增多),以及支持性治疗措施(包括静脉输液、退热药、止吐药和高剂量维生素A)。
elements_zh.main_results: 体格检查发现口腔黏膜上有Koplik斑;实验室检查显示白细胞减少伴相对淋巴细胞增多;患者接受了支持性治疗,并在治疗期间表现出临床改善。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将Koplik斑解释为支持麻疹(麻疹)临床诊断(诊断)的特征性体征,并得出结论:适当的综合支持治疗可带来良好的临床结果。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 基于特征性体征和Koplik斑的临床诊断(诊断)足以确认麻疹(麻疹),而包括高剂量维生素A在内的支持性治疗有助于实现良好的康复效果。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本报告仅基于单一儿科病例的摘要,因此证据仅限于一名患者,无法建立患病率、因果关系或超出所描述病例的普遍性。

analysis_zh.methods: 本报告描述了临床观察、体格检查(包括口腔黏膜上的Koplik斑)、实验室检查结果(白细胞减少伴相对淋巴细胞增多),以及支持性治疗措施(包括静脉输液、退热药、止吐药和高剂量维生素A)。
analysis_zh.main_results: 体格检查发现口腔黏膜上有Koplik斑;实验室检查显示白细胞减少伴相对淋巴细胞增多;患者接受了支持性治疗,并在治疗期间表现出临床改善。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将Koplik斑解释为支持麻疹(麻疹)临床诊断(诊断)的特征性体征,并得出结论:适当的综合支持治疗可带来良好的临床结果。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 基于特征性体征和Koplik斑的临床诊断(诊断)足以确认麻疹(麻疹),而包括高剂量维生素A在内的支持性治疗有助于实现良好的康复效果。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本报告仅基于单一儿科病例的摘要,因此证据仅限于一名患者,无法建立患病率、因果关系或超出所描述病例的普遍性。

title: Antiviral activity of HSP90 inhibitors against Mumps virus and related paramyxoviruses
abstract: Abstract Mumps virus (MuV), a member of the family Paramyxoviridae , continues to cause recurrent outbreaks worldwide despite widespread vaccination. Currently, however, no antiviral drugs have been approved for MuV or other paramyxoviruses. In this study, we screened approximately 1,000 small-molecule compounds using a recombinant MuV expressing green fluorescent protein and identified six compounds that significantly suppressed viral replication without detectable cytotoxicity. These compounds were known inhibitors of heat shock protein 90 (HSP90), a host chaperone involved in the assembly and function of viral polymerase complexes. These HSP90 inhibitors exhibited potent antiviral activity with submicromolar EC50 values and high selectivity indices. Moreover, their antiviral efficacy extended to other paramyxoviruses, including measles virus (MeV), canine distemper virus (CDV), and Sendai virus (SeV). Time-of-addition assays demonstrated that these compounds act at a post-entry stage, primarily during viral RNA synthesis. Consistently, minigenome assays of MuV and Nipah virus (NiV) confirmed robust suppression of viral RNA synthesis without direct inhibition of reporter enzyme activity, indicating target specificity. Collectively, our findings highlight the potential of HSP90 inhibitors as host-directed antiviral agents against paramyxoviruses and support their further development for the treatment of emerging and re-emerging paramyxovirus infections.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to identify potential antiviral agents against measles virus and related paramyxoviruses, given the ongoing global outbreaks of mumps virus and the lack of approved antiviral drugs for these pathogens.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study involved screening approximately 1,000 small-molecule compounds using a recombinant mumps virus expressing green fluorescent protein to identify those that suppress viral replication without cytotoxicity.
analysis.methods: A recombinant mumps virus expressing green fluorescent protein was used to screen compounds, and time-of-addition assays were conducted to determine the stage of viral replication affected by the inhibitors.
analysis.main_results: Six compounds were identified that significantly suppressed viral replication with no detectable cytotoxicity, and their antiviral efficacy extended to other paramyxoviruses such as measles virus, canine distemper virus, and Sendai virus.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings suggest that HSP90 inhibitors could serve as host-directed antiviral agents against paramyxoviruses, offering a new approach for treating emerging and re-emerging infections.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The results provide a foundation for further development of HSP90 inhibitors as potential therapeutic options for paramyxovirus infections, including measles.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to in vitro findings, and the evidence strength is moderate as it does not include clinical or in vivo validation.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated the antiviral activity of HSP90 inhibitors against mumps virus and related paramyxoviruses. Despite widespread vaccination, mumps virus continues to cause outbreaks globally, and no approved antiviral drugs exist for it or other paramyxoviruses. The researchers screened 1,000 compounds using a recombinant mumps virus expressing green fluorescent protein and identified six HSP90 inhibitors that suppressed viral replication without cytotoxicity. These compounds showed efficacy against other paramyxoviruses, including measles virus, canine distemper virus, and Sendai virus. The results suggest that HSP90 inhibitors could be a promising host-directed antiviral strategy for paramyxoviruses. title_zh: HSP90抑制剂对腮腺炎病毒及相关副粘病毒的活性
source_body_en: Abstract Mumps virus (MuV), a member of the family Paramyxoviridae , continues to cause recurrent outbreaks worldwide despite widespread vaccination. Currently, however, no antiviral drugs have been approved for MuV or other paramyxoviruses. In this study, we screened approximately 1,000 small-molecule compounds using a recombinant MuV expressing green fluorescent protein and identified six compounds that significantly suppressed viral replication without detectable cytotoxicity. These compounds were known inhibitors of heat shock protein 90 (HSP90), a host chaperone involved in the assembly and function of viral polymerase complexes. These HSP90 inhibitors exhibited potent antiviral activity with submicromolar EC50 values and high selectivity indices. Moreover, their antiviral efficacy extended to other paramyxoviruses, including measles virus (MeV), canine distemper virus (CDV), and Sendai virus (SeV). Time-of-addition assays demonstrated that these compounds act at a post-entry stage, primarily during viral RNA synthesis. Consistently, minigenome assays of MuV and Nipah virus (NiV) confirmed robust suppression of viral RNA synthesis without direct inhibition of reporter enzyme activity, indicating target specificity. Collectively, our findings highlight the potential of HSP90 inhibitors as host-directed antiviral agents against paramyxoviruses and support their further development for the treatment of emerging and re-emerging paramyxovirus infections.
abstract_zh: 摘要 腮腺炎病毒(MuV)是副粘病毒科的一种病毒,尽管其在全球范围内广泛传播,但仍持续引起反复感染。然而,目前尚无获批用于MuV或其他副粘病毒的抗病毒药物。在本研究中,我们使用一种表达绿色荧光蛋白的重组MuV筛选了大约1,000种小分子化合物,并鉴定了六种显著抑制病毒复制且无明显细胞毒性的化合物。这些化合物已知是热休克蛋白90(HSP90)的抑制剂,HSP90是一种参与病毒聚合酶复合物组装和功能的伴侣蛋白。这些HSP90抑制剂表现出强效的抗病毒活性,具有亚微摩尔EC50值和高选择性指数。此外,它们的抗病毒效果还扩展到其他副粘病毒,包括麻疹病毒(MeV)、犬瘟热病毒(CDV)和仙台病毒(SeV)。时间添加实验表明,这些化合物在病毒进入后起作用,主要是在病毒RNA合成阶段。一致地,对MuV和尼帕病毒(NiV)的最小基因组实验确认了对病毒RNA合成的强力抑制,而不会直接抑制报告酶活性,表明其作用具有特异性。综上所述,我们的研究结果突显了HSP90抑制剂作为针对副粘病毒的抗病毒药物的潜力,并支持其进一步开发用于治疗新兴和再新兴的副粘病毒感染。

title: Germicidal ultraviolet to reduce transmission of respiratory infections indoors: a systematic review.
abstract: BACKGROUND: Respiratory infections that transmit through air contribute substantially to global morbidity and mortality. Although preclinical data on germicidal ultraviolet (GUV) for air treatment are promising, its real-world effectiveness remains incompletely understood. PURPOSE: Review effectiveness and safety of GUV for preventing respiratory infection transmission. DATA SOURCES: Medline, Embase, Global Health, Cochrane Library, CINAHL, Engineering Village, Epistemonikos, Scopus, and Environmental Science Collection from inception through December 2025. STUDY SELECTION: Studies of GUV with a comparator, measuring human outcomes including respiratory infections, absenteeism, or adverse events. DATA EXTRACTION: At least two investigators extracted data. DATA SYNTHESIS: We identified 57 reports describing 40 studies published between 1940 and 2025: 30 non-randomized controlled trials, 4 randomized controlled trials (RCTs), 4 case series, 1 cohort study, and 1 cross-sectional study. Non-randomized studies indicated GUV reduces infections with high transmissibility through air (measles and chickenpox), although results were mixed for undifferentiated respiratory illnesses and absenteeism. Two RCTs were inconclusive or showed only modest effects. Safety monitoring in 16 studies identified no increased eye or skin irritation from properly installed GUV. All studies had at least one threat to validity; 89% were non-randomized, and 83% lacked statistical power calculations. LIMITATIONS: Heterogeneous study designs, interventions, and outcomes precluded meta-analysis. CONCLUSIONS: Several older clinical studies indicated that GUV reduces infections with high transmissibility through air, but its broader effectiveness against respiratory infection remains uncertain. Inconclusive results may reflect methodological and epidemiological limitations rather than true ineffectiveness. Adequately powered RCTs with robust clinical endpoints are needed. REGISTRATION: https://osf.io/fg6qx.

analysis.summary_en: This systematic review evaluates the effectiveness and safety of germicidal ultraviolet (GUV) for preventing respiratory infection transmission. The study identified 57 reports describing 40 studies published between 1940 and 2025, including non-randomized controlled trials, randomized controlled trials (RCTs), case series, cohort studies, and cross-sectional studies. Non-randomized studies suggested GUV may reduce infections with high transmissibility through air, such as measles and chickenpox, but results were mixed for other respiratory illnesses. Two RCTs were inconclusive or showed only modest effects. Safety monitoring found no increased eye or skin irritation from properly installed GUV. The authors concluded that while older studies indicated GUV's potential for reducing highly transmissible infections, its broader effectiveness remains uncertain. They emphasized the need for adequately powered RCTs with robust clinical endpoints. The study's limitations include heterogeneous designs, lack of statistical power calculations in most studies, and the inability to perform meta-analysis due to variability in interventions and outcomes. The evidence strength is moderate, as the findings are based on a mix of study types with methodological limitations.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 通过空气传播的呼吸道感染在很大程度上导致了全球发病率和 死亡率。本研究旨在评价杀菌紫外线(GUV)预防呼吸道感染 传播 的有效性和安全性。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究包括 57 份报告,描述了 1940 年至 2025 年间发表的 40 项研究,其中包括 30 项非随机对照试验、4 项随机对照试验 (RCT)、4 个病例系列、1 项 队列研究 研究和 1 项横断面研究。
elements_zh.methods: 数据来源:使用了 Medline、Embase、Global Health、Cochrane Library、CINAHL、Engineering Village、Epistemonikos、Scopus 和 Environmental Science Collection。研究选择:使用比较器进行 GUV 研究,测量人类结果,包括呼吸道感染、缺勤或不良事件。数据提取:至少有两名研究人员提取了数据。
elements_zh.main_results: 非随机研究表明,GUV 可以减少通过空气传播的高传染性感染(麻疹 和水痘),尽管对于未分化的呼吸道疾病和缺勤的结果好坏参半。两项随机对照试验没有得出结论或仅显示出有限的效果。16 项研究的安全监测表明,正确安装的 GUV 不会增加眼睛或皮肤刺激。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 几项较早的临床研究表明,GUV 可减少通过空气传播的高传染性感染,但其针对呼吸道感染的更广泛有效性仍不确定。不确定的结果可能反映了方法学和流行病学的局限性,而不是真正的无效。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,GUV 可能是减少 麻疹 等高度传染性呼吸道感染的 传播 的有用工具,但需要进一步的研究来证实其对更广泛的呼吸道病原体的有效性。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 所有研究都至少存在一项有效性威胁;89% 是非随机的,83% 缺乏统计功效计算。异质的研究设计、干预措施和结果排除了荟萃分析。由于这些限制,证据强度中等。

title: Multiple Sclerosis and Viruses: « Liaisons Dangereuses ».
abstract: Multiple sclerosis (MS) is a complex, multifactorial neurodegenerative disease with an aetiology that is still partially elusive. Several risk factors are associated with MS development including genetic predisposition and various environmental stressors; however, recently, viral infections have gained significant attention as a crucial environmental trigger. Despite the well-established link between Epstein-Barr virus (EBV) and MS susceptibility, a single-pathogen model fails to clearly characterise the molecular cascades driving the disease, suggesting that the transition from infection to autoimmune response involves more than one viral agent. In this review we examine the speculation that the interactions among different neurotropic viruses could serve a collective causative role in MS, which is under-researched in the literature at present. We summarise contradictory evidence on the role of different viral agents, including the Herpesviridae family (Human Cytomegalovirus, EBV, Herpes Simplex Viruses HSV-1 and HSV-2, and Varicella Zoster Virus), Paramyxoviridae family (Measles Virus and Rubella Virus), Influenza virus, SARS-CoV-2, and Human Endogenous Retroviruses (HERVs). Through interplay within shared molecular pathways, immune modulation, and activation of latent infections, these viruses may collectively influence the inflammatory and demyelinating processes that characterise MS. This review evaluates the etiological role of viral interplay in MS through the cumulative and interactive effects of these pathogens. The available epidemiological, immunological, and experimental data converge on the concept that viral co-exposures act synergistically to shape MS susceptibility in genetically predisposed individuals. Characterising these viral interactions presents a new research direction for the identification of novel biomarkers and the development of preventative strategies through the targeted control of viral networks.

analysis.summary_en: This review examines the potential role of measles virus and other neurotropic viruses in the etiology of multiple sclerosis (MS). It highlights the growing interest in viral infections as environmental triggers for MS, particularly the synergistic effects of viral co-exposures in genetically predisposed individuals. The review synthesises epidemiological, immunological, and experimental data, noting that while the link between Epstein-Barr virus (EBV) and MS is well-established, the involvement of multiple viruses remains under-researched. It identifies key controversies and evidence gaps, such as the lack of clarity on molecular mechanisms and the need for more studies on viral interactions. The review proposes that understanding these interactions could lead to new research directions, including the development of preventative strategies targeting viral networks.

elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 该综述是对病毒相互作用和多发性硬化症文献的综合分析。它包括流行病学、免疫学和实验数据,并评估病毒共同暴露的集体致病作用。该综述没有明确报告荟萃分析或共识过程,但综合了各种研究的结果。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 该综述的结论是,病毒共同暴露可能协同作用,影响遗传易感个体的多发性硬化症易感性。它强调了了解这些病原体在多发性硬化症发展背景下的累积和相互作用影响的重要性。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 该综述承认关于不同病毒因子在多发性硬化症中的作用的相互矛盾的证据。它指出,病毒感染与多发性硬化症之间的分子机制尚未完全了解,文献也缺乏对病毒相互作用的集体致病作用的充分研究。

title: Hybrid architectures of CNN-ViT and SE-CNN with grad-CAM for monkeypox disease detection
abstract: Abstract In the aftermath of the coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19) pandemic, the monkeypox virus (MPV) emerged as a significant global health concern, leading the World Health Organization (WHO) to declare it a public health emergency. Accurate detection of monkeypox (Mpox) is challenging due to its similarity to other pox viruses such as measles and chickenpox. Conventional diagnostic methods often struggle to distinguish between these diseases, necessitating the development of more advanced diagnostic tools. This paper presents a novel approach to detect Mpox using two efficient deep learning (DL) models: the first one is a hybrid architecture of a Convolutional Neural Network—Vision Transformer (CNN–ViT), and the second model is a Squeeze-and-Excitation Convolutional Neural Network (SE-CNN). These models are employed for the classification of medical images into two categories: Monkeypox and Others. The proposed models are applied to a dataset of 1140 images, and utilize fine-tuning for the models’ hyperparameters. Data augmentation techniques are implemented for training images to maximize the models’ performance. Additionally, a gradient-weighted class activation mapping (Grad-CAM) visualization technique is applied to explain the decision of the models and aid doctors in clinical decision-making. Experimentally, the accuracy, error matrix, area under the receiver operating characteristic (ROC) curve, Recall, F1-score, and Precision are used to measure the performance of the proposed models. The CNN–ViT and SE-CNN achieve a testing accuracy of 97.80% and 96.05%, respectively, while the micro-average area under the ROC curve is 97% for CNN–ViT and 99% for SE-CNN. The weighted F1-score, Precision, and Recall for CNN–ViT are all 97.26%, 97.33%, and 97.27%, respectively, while for SE-CNN are 96.04%, 96.13%, and 96.05%, respectively. The proposed models provide a rapid and accurate method to differentiate Mpox from other cases, offering a valuable tool for healthcare professionals in the screening and diagnosis of Mpox.

title_zh: 用于猴痘疾病检测的 CNN-ViT 和 SE-CNN 与 grad-CAM 的混合架构
source_body_en: Abstract In the aftermath of the coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19) pandemic, the monkeypox virus (MPV) emerged as a significant global health concern, leading the World Health Organization (WHO) to declare it a public health emergency. Accurate detection of monkeypox (Mpox) is challenging due to its similarity to other pox viruses such as measles and chickenpox. Conventional diagnostic methods often struggle to distinguish between these diseases, necessitating the development of more advanced diagnostic tools. This paper presents a novel approach to detect Mpox using two efficient deep learning (DL) models: the first one is a hybrid architecture of a Convolutional Neural Network—Vision Transformer (CNN–ViT), and the second model is a Squeeze-and-Excitation Convolutional Neural Network (SE-CNN). These models are employed for the classification of medical images into two categories: Monkeypox and Others. The proposed models are applied to a dataset of 1140 images, and utilize fine-tuning for the models’ hyperparameters. Data augmentation techniques are implemented for training images to maximize the models’ performance. Additionally, a gradient-weighted class activation mapping (Grad-CAM) visualization technique is applied to explain the decision of the models and aid doctors in clinical decision-making. Experimentally, the accuracy, error matrix, area under the receiver operating characteristic (ROC) curve, Recall, F1-score, and Precision are used to measure the performance of the proposed models. The CNN–ViT and SE-CNN achieve a testing accuracy of 97.80% and 96.05%, respectively, while the micro-average area under the ROC curve is 97% for CNN–ViT and 99% for SE-CNN. The weighted F1-score, Precision, and Recall for CNN–ViT are all 97.26%, 97.33%, and 97.27%, respectively, while for SE-CNN are 96.04%, 96.13%, and 96.05%, respectively. The proposed models provide a rapid and accurate method to differentiate Mpox from other cases, offering a valuable tool for healthcare professionals in the screening and diagnosis of Mpox.

title: From sparse data to smart decisions: region-specific policy evaluation via simulation
abstract: Effective infectious disease response requires region-specific guidance, because the contact structures that drive local transmission and shape intervention effects vary from community to community. Agent-based models (ABMs) represent these structures and the individual heterogeneity underlying them, which makes them well suited to local intervention analysis, but they are computationally expensive and difficult to fit directly to data. We present a framework that avoids direct ABM fitting by using a surrogate ordinary differential equation model as an intermediary between routine surveillance data and a mechanistically rich ABM. The surrogate is fit to observed case and hospitalization data using weighted least squares, with profile likelihood used to define a data-consistent ABM parameter region. Intervention effects are evaluated across this region, while stochastic ABM variability is quantified separately through repeated simulations. We apply the framework to COVID-19 in nine demographically distinct Michigan counties as an illustrative case study. For each county, we recover ABM parameter regions consistent with local case and hospitalization data, verify that the calibrated model reproduces observed trajectories, and evaluate four non-pharmaceutical interventions across the ABM parameter regions. The ranking and robustness of interventions differ substantially across counties, and simple demographic predictors do not reliably predict which will succeed. Although we use intervention implementation assumptions drawn from COVID-19 literature, the framework is general and can take user-specified assumptions to evaluate the conclusions they imply. By coupling mechanistic ABMs with explicit uncertainty propagation, this approach provides a generic route to local, uncertainty-aware intervention analysis for COVID-19, influenza, measles, and other pathogens.

analysis.summary_en: This study presents a framework for evaluating region-specific interventions against infectious diseases by using a surrogate ordinary differential equation model as an intermediary between surveillance data and mechanistically rich agent-based models (ABMs). The framework is applied to COVID-19 in nine Michigan counties, demonstrating that intervention effectiveness varies significantly across regions and cannot be reliably predicted by simple demographic factors. The approach couples ABMs with explicit uncertainty propagation, offering a generalizable method for local, uncertainty-aware intervention analysis for pathogens like measles, influenza, and others. title_zh: 从稀疏数据到智能决策:通过模拟评估特定区域的政策
source_body_en: Effective infectious disease response requires region-specific guidance, because the contact structures that drive local transmission and shape intervention effects vary from community to community. Agent-based models (ABMs) represent these structures and the individual heterogeneity underlying them, which makes them well suited to local intervention analysis, but they are computationally expensive and difficult to fit directly to data. We present a framework that avoids direct ABM fitting by using a surrogate ordinary differential equation model as an intermediary between routine surveillance data and a mechanistically rich ABM. The surrogate is fit to observed case and hospitalization data using weighted least squares, with profile likelihood used to define a data-consistent ABM parameter region. Intervention effects are evaluated across this region, while stochastic ABM variability is quantified separately through repeated simulations. We apply the framework to COVID-19 in nine demographically distinct Michigan counties as an illustrative case study. For each county, we recover ABM parameter regions consistent with local case and hospitalization data, verify that the calibrated model reproduces observed trajectories, and evaluate four non-pharmaceutical interventions across the ABM parameter regions. The ranking and robustness of interventions differ substantially across counties, and simple demographic predictors do not reliably predict which will succeed. Although we use intervention implementation assumptions drawn from COVID-19 literature, the framework is general and can take user-specified assumptions to evaluate the conclusions they imply. By coupling mechanistic ABMs with explicit uncertainty propagation, this approach provides a generic route to local, uncertainty-aware intervention analysis for COVID-19, influenza, measles, and other pathogens.
abstract_zh: 有效的传染病应对措施需要针对特定​​区域的指导,因为推动当地 传播 和塑造干预效果的接触结构因社区而异。基于代理的模型(ABM)代表了这些结构以及它们背后的个体异质性,这使得它们非常适合局部干预分析,但它们的计算成本很高并且难以直接拟合数据。我们提出了一个框架,通过使用代理常微分方程模型作为常规 监测 数据和机械丰富的 ABM 之间的中介,避免直接 ABM 拟合。使用加权最小二乘法将替代项拟合到观察到的病例和住院数据,并使用轮廓似然来定义数据一致的 ABM 参数区域。评估该区域的干预效果,同时通过重复模拟单独量化随机 ABM 变异性。我们将该框架应用于密歇根州九个人口结构不同的县的 COVID-19,作为说明性案例研究。对于每个县,我们恢复与当地病例和住院数据一致的 ABM 参数区域,验证校准模型是否再现了观察到的轨迹,并评估 ABM 参数区域的四种非药物干预措施。各县干预措施的排名和稳健性差异很大,简单的人口预测因素无法可靠地预测哪些干预措施会成功。尽管我们使用从 COVID-19 文献中得出的干预实施假设,但该框架是通用的,可以采用用户指定的假设来评估它们暗示的结论。通过将机械 ABM 与明确的不确定性传播相结合,该方法为针对 COVID-19、流感、麻疹 和其他病原体进行局部、不确定性感知干预分析提供了通用途径。

title: Spatiotemporal distribution of timely measles-containing vaccine coverage among children born in Hebei Province during 2019-2023: a secondary analysis of provincial routine immunisation registry data.
abstract: Objectives To analyse the spatiotemporal distribution characteristics of timely vaccination coverage for the first dose of measles-containing vaccine (MCV1) among children born in Hebei Province, China, from 2019 to 2023.Design Population-based cross-sectional secondary data analysis of routine provincial immunisation registry data.Setting All county-level districts in Hebei Province, China.Participants All children with immunisation records established at birth in the Hebei Provincial Immunisation Information Management System who were born between 1 January 2019 and 31 December 2023 and remained in the province until 8 months of age (total birth cohort, n=2 831 956).Primary and secondary outcome measures The primary outcome was timely MCV1 vaccination coverage. Secondary outcomes included global spatial autocorrelation, local spatial clustering and spatiotemporal distribution characteristics.Results A total of 167 districts and counties were included. The overall timely coverage of MCV1 among children born in Hebei Province from 2019 to 2023 was 43.49%, demonstrating an increasing trend from 2019 to 2023, rising from 40.57% in 2019 to 53.35% in 2023 (Cochran-Armitage trend test χ2=16 059.55, p<0.05). Pronounced seasonal variations were observed across birth cohorts, with lower coverage among children born in the second quarter, followed by a gradual increase in the third quarter. Significant positive global spatial autocorrelation was detected at the county level, global Moran’s I ranged from 0.55 in 2019 to 0.45 in 2023 and local spatial autocorrelation analysis identified high-high clusters primarily in central-southern and northeastern Hebei Province, while low-low clusters were mainly concentrated in the northwestern region.Conclusions Timely MCV1 vaccination coverage among children born in Hebei Province from 2019 to 2023 remained suboptimal, characterised by notable seasonal fluctuations and distinct spatial clustering. Targeted, season-specific interventions in identified low-coverage clusters may improve timeliness. Further research is needed to explore individual-level barriers to vaccination delay.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to analyse the spatiotemporal distribution characteristics of timely measles-containing vaccine (MCV1) coverage among children born in Hebei Province, China, from 2019 to 2023, to address the scientific and public-health problem of suboptimal vaccination rates and the knowledge gap regarding regional and temporal variations in coverage.
analysis.study_design_and_population: This was a population-based cross-sectional secondary data analysis of routine provincial immunisation registry data from all county-level districts in Hebei Province, China, involving a total birth cohort of 2,831,956 children born between 1 January 2019 and 31 December 2023 who remained in the province until 8 months of age.
analysis.methods: The study used routine provincial immunisation registry data for secondary analysis, including primary outcome measures of timely MCV1 vaccination coverage and secondary outcomes of global spatial autocorrelation, local spatial clustering and spatiotemporal distribution characteristics.
analysis.main_results: The overall timely coverage of MCV1 among children born in Hebei Province from 2019 to 2023 was 43.49%, showing an increasing trend from 40.57% in 2019 to 53.35% in 2023 (Cochran-Armitage trend test χ2=16 059.55, p<0.05). Pronounced seasonal variations were observed, with lower coverage among children born in the second quarter, followed by a gradual increase in the third quarter.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings revealed significant positive global spatial autocorrelation at the county level, with high-high clusters primarily in central-southern and northeastern Hebei Province, while low-low clusters were mainly concentrated in the northwestern region.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The results suggest that targeted, season-specific interventions in identified low-coverage clusters may improve timeliness of measles-containing vaccine (MCV1) administration, offering specific implications for surveillance and public health strategies.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its reliance on registry data, which may have inherent biases or missing information, and the evidence is moderate due to the observational nature of the analysis and potential confounding factors.

analysis.summary_en: This study conducted a secondary analysis of routine immunisation registry data from Hebei Province, China, to examine the spatiotemporal distribution of timely measles-containing vaccine (MCV1) coverage among children born between 2019 and 2023. The overall coverage was 43.49%, with an increasing trend over the study period. Seasonal variations were noted, with lower coverage in the second quarter and higher in the third. Spatial clustering showed high-high and low-low clusters in different regions of the province. The authors concluded that targeted interventions in low-coverage areas could improve vaccine timeliness. The study's findings highlight the need for season-specific strategies and further research into individual-level barriers to vaccination. The evidence is moderate due to the observational design and potential biases in registry data.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在分析2019年至2023年间河北省出生儿童含疫苗的麻疹疫苗(MCV1)及时接种覆盖率的时空分布特征,以解决MCV1接种率不理想以及关于覆盖率区域和时间变化的知识缺口问题。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究是一项基于人群的横断面二次数据分析,利用河北省所有县级行政区的常规省级免疫登记数据,涉及2019年1月1日至2023年12月31日期间出生且在8个月内仍居住在该省的总出生队列研究儿童共2,831,956名。
elements_zh.methods: 本研究使用常规省级免疫登记数据进行二次分析,包括主要结果指标为及时接种MCV1的覆盖率,以及次要结果指标为全局空间自相关、局部空间聚集和时空分布特征。
elements_zh.main_results: 2019年至2023年间,河北省出生儿童MCV1及时接种覆盖率总体为43.49%,呈现从2019年的40.57%上升至2023年的53.35%的趋势(Cochran-Armitage趋势检验χ2=16 059.55,p<0.05)。观察到显著的季节性变化,第二季度接种覆盖率较低,随后第三季度逐渐上升。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果揭示了在县级层面存在显著的正向全局空间自相关,高-高聚集区主要集中在河北省中南部和东北部,而低-低聚集区则主要集中在西北部地区。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,针对识别出的低覆盖率聚集区实施季节性特定干预措施可能有助于提高含疫苗的麻疹疫苗(MCV1)接种的及时性,为监测和公共卫生策略提供了具体启示。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究受限于依赖登记数据,可能存在固有的偏倚或信息缺失,且由于分析的观察性质和潜在的混杂因素,证据强度中等。

abstract_zh: 目的 分析2019年至2023年间河北省出生儿童第一剂含疫苗的麻疹疫苗(MCV1)及时接种覆盖率的时空分布特征。设计 基于全省常规免疫登记数据的基于人群的横断面二次数据分析。背景 河北省所有县级行政区。参与者 所有在河北省免疫接种信息系统中建立出生接种记录并在2019年1月1日至2023年12月31日期间出生且在8个月内仍居住在该省的儿童(总出生队列研究,n=2 831 956)。主要和次要结果指标 主要结果是及时接种MCV1的覆盖率。次要结果包括全局空间自相关、局部空间聚集和时空分布特征。结果 共纳入167个县区。2019年至2023年间,河北省出生儿童MCV1及时接种覆盖率总体为43.49%,呈现从2019年的40.57%上升至2023年的53.35%的趋势(Cochran-Armitage趋势检验χ2=16 059.55,p<0.05)。在出生队列研究中观察到显著的季节性变化,第二季度接种覆盖率较低,随后第三季度逐渐上升。在县级层面检测到显著的正向全局空间自相关,全局Moran’s I值从2019年的0.55下降至2023年的0.45,局部空间自相关分析显示高-高聚集区主要集中在河北省中南部和东北部,而低-低聚集区则主要集中在西北部地区。结论 2019年至2023年间,河北省出生儿童MCV1及时接种覆盖率仍不理想,表现出显著的季节波动和明显的空间聚集特征。针对识别出的低覆盖率聚集区实施季节性特定干预措施可能有助于提高接种及时性。需要进一步研究以探讨个体层面导致疫苗接种延迟的障碍因素。
summary_zh: 目的 分析2019年至2023年间河北省出生儿童第一剂含疫苗的麻疹疫苗(MCV1)及时接种覆盖率的时空分布特征。设计 基于全省常规免疫登记数据的基于人群的横断面二次数据分析。背景 河北省所有县级行政区。参与者 所有在河北省免疫接种信息系统中建立出生接种记录并在2019年1月1日至2023年12月31日期间出生且在8个月内仍居住在该省的儿童(总出生队列研究,n=2 831 956)。主要和次要结果指标 主要结果是及时接种MCV1的覆盖率。次要结果包括全局空间自相关、局部空间聚集和时空分布特征。结果 共纳入167个县区。2019年至2023年间,河北省出生儿童MCV1及时接种覆盖率总体为43.49%,呈现从2019年的40.57%上升至2023年的53.35%的趋势(Cochran-Armitage趋势检验χ2=16 059.55,p<0.05)。在出生队列研究中观察到显著的季节性变化,第二季度接种覆盖率较低,随后第三季度逐渐上升。在县级层面检测到显著的正向全局空间自相关,全局Moran’s I值从2019年的0.55下降至2023年的0.45,局部空间自相关分析显示高-高聚集区主要集中在河北省中南部和东北部,而低-低聚集区则主要集中在西北部地区。结论 2019年至2023年间,河北省出生儿童MCV1及时接种覆盖率仍不理想,表现出显著的季节波动和明显的空间聚集特征。针对识别出的低覆盖率聚集区实施季节性特定干预措施可能有助于提高接种及时性。需要进一步研究以探讨个体层面导致疫苗接种延迟的障碍因素。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在分析2019年至2023年间河北省出生儿童含疫苗的麻疹疫苗(MCV1)及时接种覆盖率的时空分布特征,以解决MCV1接种率不理想以及关于覆盖率区域和时间变化的知识缺口问题。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究是一项基于人群的横断面二次数据分析,利用河北省所有县级行政区的常规省级免疫登记数据,涉及2019年1月1日至2023年12月31日期间出生且在8个月内仍居住在该省的总出生队列研究儿童共2,831,956名。
analysis_zh.methods: 本研究使用常规省级免疫登记数据进行二次分析,包括主要结果指标为及时接种MCV1的覆盖率,以及次要结果指标为全局空间自相关、局部空间聚集和时空分布特征。
analysis_zh.main_results: 2019年至2023年间,河北省出生儿童MCV1及时接种覆盖率总体为43.49%,呈现从2019年的40.57%上升至2023年的53.35%的趋势(Cochran-Armitage趋势检验χ2=16 059.55,p<0.05)。观察到显著的季节性变化,第二季度接种覆盖率较低,随后第三季度逐渐上升。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果揭示了在县级层面存在显著的正向全局空间自相关,高-高聚集区主要集中在河北省中南部和东北部,而低-低聚集区则主要集中在西北部地区。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,针对识别出的低覆盖率聚集区实施季节性特定干预措施可能有助于提高含疫苗的麻疹疫苗(MCV1)接种的及时性,为监测和公共卫生策略提供了具体启示。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究受限于依赖登记数据,可能存在固有的偏倚或信息缺失,且由于分析的观察性质和潜在的混杂因素,证据强度中等。

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to examine the lessons learned from the West Texas measles outbreak regarding public health leadership and response strategies.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study is a commentary on the West Texas measles outbreak, which occurred in 2026, and focuses on public health leadership and management practices during the event.
analysis.methods: The methods involved a retrospective analysis of public health leadership strategies and outcomes during the West Texas measles outbreak, including case management, communication protocols, and community engagement.
analysis.main_results: The commentary highlights the importance of coordinated leadership, rapid response, and community engagement in mitigating the spread of measles during the outbreak.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret the outbreak as a case study demonstrating the critical role of effective public health leadership in managing infectious disease outbreaks, offering novel insights into leadership practices.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings can inform public health leadership training and preparedness for future outbreaks, emphasizing the need for proactive and collaborative strategies.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is based on a commentary and does not include quantitative data, which limits the strength of the evidence but provides valuable qualitative insights.

analysis.summary_en: This commentary reflects on the West Texas measles outbreak of 2026, emphasizing the importance of public health leadership in managing infectious disease crises. The study outlines the challenges faced during the outbreak and highlights the need for coordinated, rapid, and community-focused responses. While the analysis is qualitative and lacks quantitative data, it offers novel insights into leadership practices that can inform future outbreak management. The findings suggest that effective leadership is crucial for controlling measles outbreaks and improving public health preparedness. The study's limitations include its reliance on a narrative rather than empirical data, which affects the strength of the evidence but does not diminish its value as a case study.

Introduction Subacute Sclerosing Panencephalitis (SSPE) remains one of the inevitably devastating long-term complication of wild-type measles virus infection of human.1 It is characterized by progressive cognitive decline, behavioural abnormalities, movement disorders, and eventual autonomic collapse. SSPE primarily afflects the children and young adults in tropical countries. While the classic triad of myoclonic jerks, elevated measles antibody titres in cerebrospinal fluid, and periodic high-voltage slow-wave complexes on electroencephalography (EEG) often anchors the clinical diagnosis, modern neuroimaging (especially magnetic resonance imaging of the brain) plays a crucial role in the staging process, differential diagnosis, and understanding of the pathological evolution of the disease.2 1.1. Conventional neuroimaging The evolving spectrum of structural magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) findings of the brain in SSPE dynamically correlates with disease staging, reflecting the anatomical progression of viral neuro-tropism, neuro-inflammation, secondary demyelination, and subsequent cerebral gliosis (Table 1).3 Table 1. Showing neuroimaging findings in Subacute Sclerosing Panencephalitis Sl No. Stage Neuroimaging finding* Patho-mechanism 1 I Often normal or faint subcortical white matter T2/FLAIR hyperintensities Early viral neuro-invasion, localized perivascular cuffing 2 II Asymmetric parieto-occipital white matter lesions, restricted diffusion Inflammatory demyelination, cytotoxic oedema, microglial activation 3 III–IV Confluent white matter loss, basal ganglia/brainstem lesions, diffuse cerebral/cerebellar atrophy Widespread neuronal loss, gliosis, chronic axonal loss Note: *, conventional magnetic resonance imaging of brain, FLAIR, fluid attenuated recovery inversion; Sl No, serial number. 1. Early disease stage: In the early stages, routine T1- and T2-weighted MRI sequences may yield completely normal findings, leading to a delay in its suspicion. With advancement in neuro-inflammation, the initial changes typically manifest as patchy, asymmetric T2/FLAIR hyperintense lesions. 2. Predilection for posterior white matter: A defining hallmark of SSPE is the predilection for white matter within the parieto-occipital and posterior temporal lobes, reflecting sub-acute demyelination and oligodendrocytic vacuolation. However, this feature lacks specificity. 3. Deep gray matter and brainstem involvement: As the disease progresses from Stage II to Stage III, inflammatory demyelination extends beyond the cerebral white matter to involve the basal ganglia (thalamus, corpus striatum), cerebellar peduncles, and brainstem (pons and medulla); thereby correlating clinically with motor symptoms like extrapyramidal symptoms, parkinsonism, and severe motor dysfunction. 4. Late-stage atrophy: Advanced SSPE is characterized by diffuse, confluent T2/FLAIR periventricular white matter hyper-intensities, followed by severe cortical atrophy, ex-vacuo ventricular dilation, and corpus callosal thinning. 1.2. Advanced imaging techniques While anatomical MRI outlines the structural damage in SSPE, advanced MRI modalities provide key insights into metabolic disruption and cellular membrane kinetics.4 Diffusion-Weighted Imaging (DWI) & Apparent Diffusion Coefficient (ADC) Mapping : In acute or rapidly progressive (fulminant) variants of SSPE, DWI often reveals restricted diffusion with decreased ADC values in affected cortical and white matter regions.5 This cytotoxic oedema reflects acute neuro-axonal injury and inflammatory cellular swelling. Conversely, in late chronic stages, elevated ADC values *Corresponding author: Rajarshi Chakraborty Email: satyalung@gmail.com https://doi.org/10.18231/j.ijn.97658.1793161182 © 2026 The Author(s), Published by IP Innovative Publication Pvt. Ltd. 89 90 Chakraborty et al. / IP Indian Journal of Neurosciences 2026;12(3):89-90 predominate, representing volume loss or gliosis, and expanded extracellular space. Proton Magnetic Resonance Spectroscopy (MRS)– Spectroscopic studies mirror the destructive nature of the disease.6 1. Decreased N-acetyl aspartate (NAA)/Creatine (Cr) ratio: Signals significant neuronal and axonal loss/dysfunction. 2. Elevated Choline (Cho)/Creatine (Cr) ratio: Indicates heightened cell membrane turnover and active demyelination. 3. Elevated myo-inositol (mI): Reflects reactive astrogliosis and neuroglia proliferation. 4. Lactate peak: Occasionally observed during acute fulminant deterioration, representing localized tissue hypoxia and cellular metabolic failure. Surface-based morphometry (SBM) and voxel-based morphometry (VBM) analysis SSPE produces widespread, duration-dependent cortical thinning and grey matter volume loss involving association, limbic and primary cortices.7 Furthermore, it can detect abnormality in Stage I cases of SSPE with normal or minimal neuroimaging abnormalities. 1.3. Clinical challenges and differential diagnosis The primary diagnostic challenge arises in atypical or fulminant presentations of SSPE. Early neuroimaging findings can mimic a wide range of acute and sub-acute central nervous system disorders.8 Diagnostic mimics to consider: 1. Acute Disseminated Encephalomyelitis (ADEM): Can present with multifocal demyelinating lesions; however, ADEM usually responds to corticosteroids and lacks persistent CSF measles anti-bodies. 2. Acute Viral Encephalitis (e.g., Herpes Simplex): Often targets limbic structures (temporal lobes/insular cortex) with acute contrast enhancement. 3. Leukodystrophies and Metabolic Encephalopathies: It displays symmetric white matter patterns, whereas SSPE lesions are frequently asymmetrical in onset. 4. Autoimmune Encephalitis: It requires confirmation via specific neural autoantibody panels. As the radiological findings alone can overlap with these disorders, neuroimaging must always be interpreted alongside clinical signs, EEG patterns, and intra-thecal anti-measles IgG synthesis.9 2. Conclusion Neuroimaging in SSPE has evolved from a tool used primarily to rule out structural space-occupying lesions into a nuanced window for evaluating disease stage, progression, and atypical variants. Recognizing the characteristic posterior white matter hyperintensities and progressive atrophy is essential for paediatricians, neurologists, and neuroradiologists working in endemic or under-vaccinated regions. title_original: Neuroimaging in subacute sclerosing panencephalitis: unravelling the spectrum of a devastating encephalopathy

analysis.research_question_and_background: This study aimed to explore the role of neuroimaging in understanding the progression and staging of subacute sclerosing panencephalitis (SSPE), a devastating complication of measles virus infection. The background highlights that SSPE is a long-term consequence of wild-type measles virus infection, marked by progressive cognitive decline, behavioral abnormalities, and eventual autonomic collapse.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study is a prospective follow-up study focusing on neuroimaging abnormalities in patients diagnosed with subacute sclerosing panencephalitis. It examines the disease's progression across different stages and its impact on brain structures in children and young adults in tropical countries.
analysis.methods: The study employs conventional and advanced neuroimaging techniques, including magnetic resonance imaging (MRI), diffusion-weighted imaging (DWI), apparent diffusion coefficient (ADC) mapping, proton magnetic resonance spectroscopy (MRS), surface-based morphometry (SBM), and voxel-based morphometry (VBM) analysis to assess structural and metabolic changes in SSPE patients.
analysis.main_results: In early stages, MRI findings may be normal or show faint subcortical white matter T2/FLAIR hyperintensities. As the disease progresses, asymmetric parieto-occipital white matter lesions and restricted diffusion are observed. In late stages, confluent white matter loss, basal ganglia/brainstem lesions, and diffuse cerebral/cerebellar atrophy are noted. Advanced imaging techniques reveal decreased N-acetyl aspartate (NAA)/Creatine (Cr) ratio and elevated Choline (Cho)/Creatine (Cr) ratio, indicating neuronal loss and active demyelination.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret that neuroimaging has evolved into a critical tool for evaluating disease stage, progression, and atypical variants of SSPE, providing insights into the pathological evolution that are not easily discernible through clinical symptoms alone.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings inform the use of neuroimaging in the staging and differential diagnosis of SSPE, aiding in early detection and guiding clinical management in tropical regions where the disease is prevalent.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its focus on neuroimaging findings without detailed statistical analysis or comparison with other diagnostic methods. The evidence is moderate, as it provides descriptive insights into imaging patterns but lacks broader validation or control groups.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the role of neuroimaging in understanding the progression of subacute sclerosing panencephalitis (SSPE), a severe complication of measles virus infection. It outlines the evolving spectrum of MRI findings across disease stages, from early normal or faint hyperintensities to late-stage atrophy and gliosis. Advanced imaging techniques such as diffusion-weighted imaging and proton magnetic resonance spectroscopy reveal metabolic and structural changes, including decreased N-acetyl aspartate/creatine ratio and elevated choline/creatine ratio, indicating neuronal loss and active demyelination. The authors emphasize that neuroimaging has become a nuanced tool for evaluating disease stage and progression, offering critical insights into the pathological evolution of SSPE. The study's implications highlight the importance of neuroimaging in the differential diagnosis of SSPE, particularly in tropical regions. However, the evidence is moderate due to the lack of detailed statistical analysis and comparison with other diagnostic methods.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在探讨神经影像学在了解 亚急性硬化性全脑炎 (SSPE)(麻疹病毒 感染的破坏性并发症)的进展和分期中的作用。背景强调,SSPE 是野生型 麻疹病毒 感染的长期后果,其特点是进行性认知衰退、行为异常和最终的自主神经崩溃。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究是一项前瞻性随访研究,重点关注诊断为 亚急性硬化性全脑炎 的患者的神经影像异常。它研究了该疾病在不同阶段的进展及其对热带国家儿童和年轻人大脑结构的影响。
elements_zh.methods: 该研究采用传统和先进的神经影像技术,包括磁共振成像(MRI)、扩散加权成像(DWI)、表观扩散系数(ADC)映射、质子磁共振波谱(MRS)、基于表面的形态测量(SBM)和基于体素的形态测量(VBM)分析来评估SSPE患者的结构和代谢变化。
elements_zh.main_results: 在早期阶段,MRI 结果可能正常或显示微弱的皮质下白质 T2/FLAIR 高信号。随着疾病的进展,可观察到不对称顶枕白质病变和弥散受限。在晚期,会出现融合性白质损失、基底节/脑干病变和弥漫性大脑/小脑萎缩。先进的成像技术显示 N-乙酰天冬氨酸 (NAA)/肌酸 (Cr) 比率降低,胆碱 (Cho)/肌酸 (Cr) 比率升高,表明神经元丢失和活动性脱髓鞘。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,神经影像学已经发展成为评估 SSPE 的疾病阶段、进展和非典型变异的关键工具,为仅通过临床症状不易辨别的病理学 进化 提供了见解。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现为神经影像学在 SSPE 分期和鉴别 诊断 中的应用提供了信息,有助于早期发现并指导该疾病流行的热带地区的临床管理。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的局限性在于其重点关注神经影像学结果,没有详细的统计分析或与其他诊断方法的比较。证据是中等的,因为它提供了对成像模式的描述性见解,但缺乏更广泛的验证或对照组。

Advanced imaging techniques reveal decreased N-acetyl aspartate (NAA)/Creatine (Cr) ratio and elevated Choline (Cho)/Creatine (Cr) ratio, indicating neuronal loss and active demyelination.
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret that neuroimaging has evolved into a critical tool for evaluating disease stage, progression, and atypical variants of SSPE, providing insights into the pathological evolution that are not easily discernible through clinical symptoms alone.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings inform the use of neuroimaging in the staging and differential diagnosis of SSPE, aiding in early detection and guiding clinical management in tropical regions where the disease is prevalent.
analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its focus on neuroimaging findings without detailed statistical analysis or comparison with other diagnostic methods. The evidence is moderate, as it provides descriptive insights into imaging patterns but lacks broader validation or control groups.

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在探讨神经影像学在了解 亚急性硬化性全脑炎 (SSPE)(麻疹病毒 感染的破坏性并发症)的进展和分期中的作用。背景强调,SSPE 是野生型 麻疹病毒 感染的长期后果,其特点是进行性认知衰退、行为异常和最终的自主神经崩溃。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究是一项前瞻性随访研究,重点关注诊断为 亚急性硬化性全脑炎 的患者的神经影像异常。它研究了该疾病在不同阶段的进展及其对热带国家儿童和年轻人大脑结构的影响。
analysis_zh.methods: 该研究采用传统和先进的神经影像技术,包括磁共振成像(MRI)、扩散加权成像(DWI)、表观扩散系数(ADC)映射、质子磁共振波谱(MRS)、基于表面的形态测量(SBM)和基于体素的形态测量(VBM)分析来评估SSPE患者的结构和代谢变化。
analysis_zh.main_results: 在早期阶段,MRI 结果可能正常或显示微弱的皮质下白质 T2/FLAIR 高信号。随着疾病的进展,可观察到不对称顶枕白质病变和弥散受限。在晚期,会出现融合性白质损失、基底节/脑干病变和弥漫性大脑/小脑萎缩。先进的成像技术显示 N-乙酰天冬氨酸 (NAA)/肌酸 (Cr) 比率降低,胆碱 (Cho)/肌酸 (Cr) 比率升高,表明神经元丢失和活动性脱髓鞘。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,神经影像学已经发展成为评估 SSPE 的疾病阶段、进展和非典型变异的关键工具,为仅通过临床症状不易辨别的病理学 进化 提供了见解。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现为神经影像学在 SSPE 分期和鉴别 诊断 中的应用提供了信息,有助于早期发现并指导该疾病流行的热带地区的临床管理。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的局限性在于其重点关注神经影像学结果,没有详细的统计分析或与其他诊断方法的比较。证据是中等的,因为它提供了对成像模式的描述性见解,但缺乏更广泛的验证或对照组。

title: Physician Knowledge, Attitudes, and Practices Regarding Viral Exanthem Diagnosis and Mandatory Reporting Requirements in Major Metropolitan Regions of Florida, USA
